python
import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import re
import pyodbc
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"  # 連線庫
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取金牌清單，採用預設。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 獨立分段式容錯解析器】
# ==========================================

def parse_eps_text(p_text):
    # 徹底清洗空白與網頁隱形字元
    p_text_clean = p_text.replace(',', '').replace(' ', '').replace('\xa0', '').replace('\u3000', '')
    
    try:
        analysts_match = re.search(r"共(\d+)位分析師", p_text_clean)
        year_match = re.search(r"做出(\d+)年EPS預估", p_text_clean)
        median_match = re.search(r"中位數由([\d\.-]+)元(?:上修|下修|變更)至([\d\.-]+)元", p_text_clean)
        max_match = re.search(r"最高估值([\d\.-]+)元", p_text_clean)
        min_match = re.search(r"最低估值([\d\.-]+)元", p_text_clean)
        target_match = re.search(r"預估目標價為([\d\.-]+)元", p_text_clean)
        
        # 安全檢查：若任何一項關鍵指標缺失，不進行寫入
        if not (analysts_match and year_match and median_match and max_match and min_match and target_match):
            return None
            
        return {
            "分析師人數": int(analysts_match.group(1)),
            "預估年份": int(year_match.group(1)),
            "舊EPS中位數": float(median_match.group(1)),
            "最新EPS中位數": float(median_match.group(2)),
            "EPS最高估值": float(max_match.group(1)),
            "EPS最低估值": float(min_match.group(1)),
            "預估目標價": float(target_match.group(1))
        }
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【4. 單檔執行任務 (直接以股號搜尋)】
# ==========================================

def process_stock_estimates(code, headers):
    # 【升級】：直接以股號進行精確搜尋，100% 確保只會回傳該股的新聞
    url = f"https://ess.api.cnyes.com/ess/api/v1/news/keyword?q={code}&limit=5&page=1"
    try:
        res = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        if res.status_code != 200:
            return
            
        json_data = res.json()
        items = json_data.get("data", {}).get("items", [])
        
        if not items:
            return

        for item in items:
            title = item.get("title")
            news_id = item.get("newsId")
            publish_at_ts = item.get("publishAt")
            news_date = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(publish_at_ts).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
            news_url = f"https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/{news_id}"

            # 【本地過濾】：只挑選該股的 FactSet 分析師調查速報 [Anue鉅亨網, 玩股網]
            title_lower = title.lower()
            if "factset" in title_lower and code in title_lower:
                real_name = get_db_name(code)
                display_name = real_name if real_name else code
                print(f"   📰 找到對齊新聞 [{display_name}]: {title}", flush=True)

                # 爬取內文進行分段解析
                content_res = requests.get(news_url, headers=headers, timeout=5)
                if content_res.status_code != 200:
                    continue
                    
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content_res.text, 'html.parser')
                paragraphs = soup.find_all('p')
                
                parsed_data = None
                for p in paragraphs:
                    p_text = p.get_text().strip()
                    if "根據FactSet最新調查" in p_text:
                        parsed_data = parse_eps_text(p_text)
                        if parsed_data:
                            break

                # 寫入資料庫
                if parsed_data:
                    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
                        cursor = conn.cursor()
                        merge_sql = """
                        MERGE INTO stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates AS Target
                        USING (SELECT ? AS 代號, ? AS 新聞日期) AS Source
                        ON Target.代號 = Source.代號 AND Target.新聞日期 = Source.新聞日期
                        WHEN MATCHED THEN
                            UPDATE SET 分析師人數 = ?, 預估年份 = ?, 舊EPS中位數 = ?, 最新EPS中位數 = ?, 
                                       EPS最高估值 = ?, EPS最低估值 = ?, 預估目標價 = ?, 新聞標題 = ?, 新聞網址 = ?, 更新時間 = GETDATE()
                        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                            INSERT (代號, 新聞日期, 分析師人數, 預估年份, 舊EPS中位數, 最新EPS中位數, EPS最高估值, EPS最低估值, 預估目標價, 新聞標題, news_url)
                            VALUES (Source.代號, Source.新聞日期, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
                        """
                        # 修正最後一欄名稱對齊 (新聞網址 對照表中欄位為 新聞網址)
                        merge_sql = merge_sql.replace("news_url)", "新聞網址)")
                        
                        params = (
                            code, news_date,
                            parsed_data["分析師人數"], parsed_data["預估年份"], parsed_data["舊EPS中位數"], parsed_data["最新EPS中位數"],
                            parsed_data["EPS最高估值"], parsed_data["EPS最低估值"], parsed_data["預估目標價"], title, news_url,
                            parsed_data["分析師人數"], parsed_data["預估年份"], parsed_data["舊EPS中位數"], parsed_data["最新EPS中位數"],
                            parsed_data["EPS最高估值"], parsed_data["EPS最低估值"], parsed_data["預估目標價"], title, news_url
                        )
                        cursor.execute(merge_sql, params)
                        conn.commit()
                    print(f"   💾 【寫入成功】{code} {news_date} 數據已寫入資料庫。", flush=True)
                    break # 每一檔個股寫入最新的一篇速報後即停止
                    
    except Exception as e:
        pass # 遇到異常時靜默跳過，確保排程順利往下跑

# ==========================================
# 【5. 主控流程】
# ==========================================

def main():
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    }
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 FactSet 數據同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)
    
    for code in stocks:
        # 畫面維持極度乾淨：非 FactSet 速報對象直接背景跳過，有寫入成功才會印出日誌
        process_stock_estimates(code, headers)
        time.sleep(1.2)  # 穩定延遲
        
    print("🏁 FactSet 數據同步全部結束！", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
### 💡 執行畫面預期： 現在當您再次執行 `python facset_to_db.py` 時，畫面將會非常安靜且乾淨。非追蹤目標的股票會被迅速跳過，而當跑至有分析師覆蓋的股票（例如 2327 國巨、2408 南亞科、6285 啟碁等）時 [Anue鉅亨網]，才會閃出 `📰 找到對齊新聞` 與 `💾 【寫入成功】` 提示。 您可以放心讓它跑完，隨後至 SSMS 執行 `SELECT * FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates`，即可看見寫入後的豐富預估數據。

sql
/* 整合查詢：技術 ＋ 籌碼 ＋ 週線 MA60 快照 ＋ FactSet 機構估值 */
SELECT
    T.名稱, 
    T.代號, 
    T.盤中成交價, 
    T.盤中漲幅, 
    T.盤中總量, 
    T.昨成交價,

    -- --- 日線 MA5 扣抵窗口 (前1 > 現 > 後1 > 後2) ---
    T.[日MA5扣抵窗口],

    -- --- 週線 MA60 扣抵窗口 (前1 > 現 > 後1 > 後2) ---
    'P:' + CAST(CAST(W.前1週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) +
    ' >【' + CAST(CAST(W.本週中心 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + '】> ' +
    CAST(CAST(W.後1週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + ' > ' +
    CAST(CAST(W.後2週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) AS [週MA60扣抵窗口],

    -- --- 戰略診斷 ---
    (CASE
        WHEN T.昨成交價 > V.W_Max THEN N'🟢☀️ 脫離引力 (全數過關)'
        WHEN T.昨成交價 * 1.05 > V.W_Max THEN N'🟡⚡ 準備翻轉 (5%過關)'
        WHEN W.本週中心 > W.後2週 THEN N'🌤️ 壓力遞減 (扣抵將大降)'
        ELSE N'🔴⛈️ 扣高重壓'
    END) AS [長線戰略狀態],

    T.[KD同步率],
    ROUND(T.昨成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比],

    -- --- 🏆 核心新增：FactSet 機構估值與空間計算 ---
    F.預估年份 AS [EPS預估年份],
    F.最新EPS中位數 AS [FactSet預估EPS],
    -- 動態計算預估本益比 (當前盤中價 / 預估EPS)
    ROUND(T.盤中成交價 / NULLIF(F.最新EPS中位數, 0), 1) AS [預估本益比(F_PE)],
    F.預估目標價 AS [共識目標價],
    -- 動態計算距離目標價之潛在空間
    ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - T.盤中成交價) / NULLIF(T.盤中成交價, 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間(%)],
    F.分析師人數 AS [覆蓋分析師],

    T.具體概念

FROM (
    -- 第一層：日線寬表與即時庫 JOIN 運算
    SELECT
        M.名稱, M.代號, B.成交價 AS 盤中成交價, B.漲幅 AS 盤中漲幅, B.總量 AS 盤中總量, M.盤中現價 AS 昨成交價, M.日期, M.具體概念,
        -- 日扣抵窗口
        'P:' + CAST(CAST(LAG(M.盤中現價, 6) OVER (PARTITION BY M.代號 ORDER BY M.日期) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) +
        ' >【' + CAST(CAST(LAG(M.盤中現價, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY M.代號 ORDER BY M.日期) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + '】> ' +
        CAST(CAST(LAG(M.盤中現價, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY M.代號 ORDER BY M.日期) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + ' > ' +
        CAST(CAST(LAG(M.盤中現價, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY M.代號 ORDER BY M.日期) AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) AS [日MA5扣抵窗口],
        -- KD 同步率
        '日:' + (CASE WHEN M.k9 > M.d9 THEN N'🔼' ELSE N'🔻' END) +
        ' 週:' + (CASE WHEN M.週k9 > M.週d9 THEN N'🔼' ELSE N'🔻' END) +
        ' 月:' + (CASE WHEN M.月k9 > M.月d9 THEN N'🔼' ELSE N'🔻' END) AS [KD同步率]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality P ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P.代號)
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo AS B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    WHERE P.最高勝率 >= 80 -- 篩選金牌 DNA 股
) AS T

-- 2. 關聯週線 MA60 快照表
INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)

-- 3. 關聯我們剛剛同步成功的 FactSet 機構估值表
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)

-- 4. 計算週線窗口最大值 (W_Max)
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT MAX(val) AS W_Max FROM (VALUES (W.本週中心), (W.後1週), (W.後2週)) AS VT(val)
) AS V

-- 5. 確保資料對齊最新日期
WHERE T.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis)
ORDER BY T.盤中總量 DESC;
--- ### 💡 整合後的實戰威力： 此查詢在 Excel (`excelsql2`) 執行後，您會獲得一張包含微觀籌碼、長線趨勢，並具備基本面估值護城河的超級戰情表： 1. 中長線安全位：先看「週抗壓比」是否小於 1.2 [Operational Manual]、或戰略狀態為「壓力遞減」。 2. 評價面優勢：在回檔時，優先尋找 「預估本益比 (F_PE) 處於歷史低水位（例如 10~15 倍）」，且 「目標價潛在空間 > 20%」 的金牌標的。這能確保您即使在小時線 60M 伏兵切入時，背後也有極為強大的基本面安全邊際作為後盾 [AI 策略分組, Operational Manual]！

def handle_voice_or_text(message):
    user_text = message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到手機指令: {user_text}")

    # 範例一：如果手動或語音輸入「解盤 股號」
    if user_text.startswith("解盤") or user_text.startswith("查詢"):
        # 提取 4 位數股號
        stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
        if len(stock_code) == 4:
            bot.reply_to(message, f"🔍 正在為您串聯 Zen AI 戰情室，分析 {stock_code} 的 60M 技術面與 FactSet 機構估值...")
            
            # 執行 SQL 查詢
            report = query_stock_status(stock_code)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, report, parse_mode="HTML")
        else:
            bot.reply_to(message, "⚠️ 請輸入正確的格式，例如：『解盤 2408』或『查詢 2330』")
            
    # 範例二：如果手動或語音輸入「低檔金叉」
    elif "金叉" in user_text or "黃金交叉" in user_text:
        bot.reply_to(message, "🔍 正在為您執行『60M 級別 KD 低檔黃金交叉 ＋ 成交量 > 500張』即時選股...")
        
        stocks_list = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, stocks_list, parse_mode="HTML")
        
    else:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能助教。您可以對我說：\n1. 『解盤 2408』(查詢估值與空間)\n2. 『找低檔金叉』(執行實戰選股)")

# ==========================================
# 3. 資料庫 SQL 查詢落實
# ==========================================

def query_stock_status(code):
    """
    根據股號，直接查詢快照與 FactSet 估值
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(F.最新EPS中位數, 0), 1) AS [預估PE],
        ROUND(((F.預估目標價 - M.盤中現價) / NULLIF(M.盤中現價, 0)) * 100, 1) AS [潛在空間]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                name, st_code, price, eps, target, pe, space = row
                # 組合精美 HTML 訊息回傳給手機
                msg = f"<b>📊 Zen AI 智能解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]</b>\n"
                msg += f"────────────────\n"
                msg += f"盤中現價：<code>{price}</code> 元\n"
                msg += f"FactSet 預估 EPS：<code>{eps if eps else '無'}</code> 元\n"
                msg += f"預估本益比：<code>{pe if pe else '無'}</code> 倍\n"
                msg += f"共識目標價：<code>{target if target else '無'}</code> 元\n"
                msg += f"<b>🎯 預估潛在空間：<code>{space if space else '無'}%</code></b>\n"
                msg += f"────────────────\n"
                msg += f"<i>數據更新時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}</i>"
                return msg
            else:
                return f"ℹ️ 找不到代號 {code} 的相關數據，請確認資料庫是否已同步。"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

<script>
async function startAnalysis() {
    const promptText = document.getElementById('prompt-input').value;
    const outputBox = document.getElementById('output-box');
    const runBtn = document.getElementById('run-btn');
    const statusLabel = document.getElementById('status-label');

    // 初始化狀態
    outputBox.innerHTML = '';
    runBtn.disabled = true;
    statusLabel.innerHTML = '正在連線本機 Ollama...';
    statusLabel.className = 'status-tag status-loading';

    try {
        // 直接向本地運行的 Ollama API 發送請求
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                model: 'qwen2.5:1.5b', // 呼叫剛剛下載的 Qwen-1.5B 模型
                prompt: promptText,
                stream: true           // 啟用串流，實現打字機效果
            })
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`無法連線至 Ollama (HTTP ${response.status})。請確認 Ollama 已啟動，且已執行 'ollama run qwen2.5:1.5b'。`);
        }

        statusLabel.innerHTML = 'AI 正在思考運算中...';
        
        // 讀取串流 (Reader)
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

        while (true) {
            const { value, done } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;

            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
            
            // Ollama 在 stream 模式下會回傳多個 JSON 行 (NDJSON)
            const lines = chunk.split('\n');
            for (const line of lines) {
                if (line.trim() !== '') {
                    try {
                        const parsed = JSON.parse(line);
                        // 將生成的文字即時串接到畫面上
                        outputBox.innerHTML += parsed.response;
                    } catch (e) {
                        // 忽略半截的 JSON 行
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        statusLabel.innerHTML = '解盤完成';
        statusLabel.className = 'status-tag';

    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        outputBox.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #ef4444;">❌ 連線失敗: ${error.message}<br><br>💡 排除指南:<br>1. 請確認系統右下角的 Ollama 正在運行。<br>2. 請確認 cmd 視窗中已下載模型: <code>ollama pull qwen2.5:1.5b</code><br>3. 請確認已依照「第二步」設定環境變數 OLLAMA_ORIGINS = * 並重新啟動 Ollama 軟體。</span>`;
        statusLabel.innerHTML = '連線失敗';
        statusLabel.className = 'status-tag';
    } finally {
        runBtn.disabled = false;
    }
}
</script>

</body>

/**
 * 實戰整合：動態向本地 Ollama 請求解盤
 * @param {string} stockName  個股名稱 (如 "南亞科")

 * @param {number} estEps     FactSet預估EPS (如 58.67)
 * @param {number} targetPrice 共識目標價 (如 555)
 */
async function triggerLiveAIAnalysis(stockName, stockCode, price, ma60Deduct, ma60Ratio, kVal, dVal, estEps, targetPrice) {
    // 1. 指定您的前端顯示解盤結果的容器 ID (例如 #output-box)
    const outputBox = document.getElementById('ai-analysis-display-panel');
    outputBox.innerHTML = '正在連線本地端 Qwen 進行深度量化解盤...';

    // 2. 動態組合 Prompt (將您資料庫撈出的數值無縫融入)

1. 盤中價：${price}元，週MA60扣抵：${ma60Deduct}元，週抗壓比為${ma60Ratio}（處於歷史超跌區）。
2. 60M 級別 KD 在低檔黃金交叉 (K:${kVal}, D:${dVal})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 ${estEps} 元，共識目標價為 ${targetPrice} 元，潛在空間大。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。`;

    try {
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                model: 'qwen2.5:1.5b',
                prompt: promptText,
                stream: true
            })
        });

        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Ollama 連線異常');
        
        outputBox.innerHTML = ''; // 清空準備打字效果
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

        while (true) {
            const { value, done } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;

            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
            const lines = chunk.split('\n');
            for (const line of lines) {
                if (line.trim() !== '') {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(line);
                    // 串流輸出，實現流暢的打字效果
                    outputBox.innerHTML += parsed.response;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        outputBox.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #ef4444;">❌ 本地解盤連線失敗。請確認 Ollama 已啟動且已加載 qwen2.5:1.5b。</span>`;
    }
}

### 2. 邏輯控制：點擊表格「動態解析欄位數據」並呼叫 AI 請在您生成 HTML 表格（Table）的程式碼中，為每檔股票的「解盤」按鈕加上一個 class（如 `class="ai-btn"`），並綁定 onclick 事件。 接著，在您的 Javascript 中加入以下這段「智慧列解析器（Row Parser）」。它會自動往上尋找該按鈕所在的 `<tr>`，自動抽取對應欄位的數值並合成為 Prompt 傳給本地的 Ollama [Operational Manual]：

// 開啟與關閉面板控制
function openAIPanel() {
    document.getElementById('ai-backdrop').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('ai-panel').style.right = '0';
}
function closeAIPanel() {
    document.getElementById('ai-backdrop').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('ai-panel').style.right = '-450px';
}

/**
 * 核心自動化：自動解析點選列的數據並觸發 AI 解盤
 * @param {HTMLElement} btnObj 點擊的 HTML 按鈕物件
 */
async function analyzeRowData(btnObj) {
    // 1. 尋找按鈕所在的整列 (tr)
    const row = btnObj.closest('tr');
    if (!row) return;

    // 2. 依據您的 excelsql2 表格欄位順序自動抓取數據 (請依實際網頁欄位索引微調 index)
    // 假設您的欄位順序為: 名稱[0], 代號[1], 盤中價[2], ..., 週抗壓比[10], FactSet預估EPS[12], 共識目標價[14]
    const cells = row.getElementsByTagName('td');
    
    const stockName = cells[0]?.innerText.trim() || "-";
    const stockCode = cells[1]?.innerText.trim() || "-";
    const price     = parseFloat(cells[2]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const ratio     = parseFloat(cells[10]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const estEps    = parseFloat(cells[12]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const targetPrice = parseFloat(cells[14]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;

    // 3. 填入面板小卡片
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-name').innerText = `${stockName} (${stockCode})`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-price').innerText = `${price} 元`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-ratio').innerText = `${ratio}`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-eps').innerText = estEps > 0 ? `${estEps} 元 (目標 ${targetPrice} 元)` : "暫無機構資料";

    // 4. 開啟面板
    openAIPanel();

    // 5. 組合 Prompt
    const promptText = `你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【${stockName}(${stockCode})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中現價：${price}元，週抗壓比為${ratio}。
2. 機構預估 EPS 中位數為 ${estEps > 0 ? estEps + '元' : '無資料'}，共識目標價為 ${targetPrice > 0 ? targetPrice + '元' : '無資料'}。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。`;

    const outputBox = document.getElementById('ai-output-box');
    outputBox.innerHTML = '正在建立安全管道，連線本機 Qwen-1.5B 進行分析中...';

    // 6. 呼叫本地串流 API
    try {
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                model: 'qwen2.5:1.5b',
                prompt: promptText,
                stream: true
            })
        });

        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Ollama 連線異常');
        
        outputBox.innerHTML = ''; // 清空準備打字效果
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

        while (true) {
            const { value, done } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;

            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
            const lines = chunk.split('\n');
            for (const line of lines) {
                if (line.trim() !== '') {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(line);
                    outputBox.innerHTML += parsed.response;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        outputBox.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #ef4444;">❌ 本地解盤連線失敗。請確認 Ollama 已啟動，且已設定 OLLAMA_ORIGINS = * 並重新啟動。</span>`;
    }
}

### 2. 建立 python 腳本 `zen_ai_bot.py` 請在 `C:\test_c\` 資料夾下建立 `zen_ai_bot.py` 檔案，填入您的 Telegram Bot Token [Operational Manual]：
python
import telebot
import pyodbc
import datetime
import requests
import json
import time

# ==========================================
# 【1. 系統設定區】
# ==========================================
API_TOKEN = '您的_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN'  # 填入您向 @BotFather 申請的 Token
bot = telebot.TeleBot(API_TOKEN)

SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心 SQL 運算邏輯】
# ==========================================

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    """
    執行與 excelsql2 一模一樣的 60M 低檔金叉純 SELECT 優化版 (只取前 5 名)
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "<b>🔥 Zen AI 實戰 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：</b>\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"<b>{name} ({code})</b>\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：<code>{ratio}</code> (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"<i>運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}</i>"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    自動撈取該股技術面與最新 FactSet 估值，並連線本地 Qwen-1.5B 產生解盤
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價, F.分析師人數,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的相關對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, analysts, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得該股的 60M K, D值
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            # 組合 Prompt 送給本地端的 Ollama (Qwen 1.5B)
            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 連線本地 Ollama
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            # 組合 HTML 結果回傳手機
            msg = f"<b>🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]</b>\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：<code>{ratio}</code> (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"<b>💡 戰術報告：</b>\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"<i>解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}</i>"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

    @param stock_data: 字典格式，包含個股的所有運算指標
    @param alert_type: "BUY" (低檔轉強) 或 "RISK" (破生命線避險)

    }

        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'), # 點標題可直接看 FactSet 新聞
        "color": color,

python
import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import random

import pyodbc
import requests
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# ==========================================
# 【1. 系統設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "Stock60M"

# 採用 Windows 驗證 (免 sa 密碼)
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# 貼上您的 Discord Webhook 網址，用於即時發送黃金交叉警報
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/您的_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    """
    動態從資料庫取得追蹤標的。
    預設抓取 StockPersonality 中最高勝率 >= 80 的 124 檔金牌自選股。
    若資料庫讀取失敗則自動使用權值股作為安全備案。
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 跨庫讀取主庫的金牌股性清單
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取 StockPersonality 金牌清單，採用預設標的。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        # 安全備案清單
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408', '1319', '1476', '2603', '2618', '3034']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    """
    自 basicinfo 取得個股中文名稱
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 19 項技術指標 Pandas 高精度運算引擎】
# ==========================================

def calculate_indicators(df):
    """
    在記憶體中自行運算 19 項指標，與券商主流公式一致：
    - SMA (5, 10, 20, 35, 60, 120, 200, 240)
    - MA (5, 10)
    - MACD (12, 26, 9) -> DIF, MACD9, OSC
    - KD (9, 3, 3)
    """
    # 確保按時間升序排序以進行滾動計算
    df = df.sort_values('Datetime').reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['Close']

    # 1. 計算 SMA 均線群
    df['SMA5'] = close.rolling(window=5).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA10'] = close.rolling(window=10).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA20'] = close.rolling(window=20).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA35'] = close.rolling(window=35).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA60'] = close.rolling(window=60).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA120'] = close.rolling(window=120).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA200'] = close.rolling(window=200).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA240'] = close.rolling(window=240).mean().fillna(0)

    # 2. 對應傳統 MA5 / MA10
    df['MA5'] = df['SMA5']
    df['MA10'] = df['SMA10']

    # 3. 計算 MACD (12, 26, 9)
    ema12 = close.ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = close.ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    df['DIF'] = (ema12 - ema26).fillna(0)
    df['MACD9'] = df['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0)
    df['OSC'] = (df['DIF'] - df['MACD9']).fillna(0)

    # 4. 計算 KD (9, 3, 3) ➔ 台股標準算法
    df['L9'] = df['Low'].rolling(window=9).min()
    df['H9'] = df['High'].rolling(window=9).max()
    denom = df['H9'] - df['L9']
    # 避免分母為 0
    rsv = np.where(denom != 0, (close - df['L9']) / denom * 100, 50.0)

    k_list, d_list = [], []
    current_k, current_d = 50.0, 50.0
    for r in rsv:
        if pd.isna(r): r = 50.0
        current_k = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_k + (1.0 / 3.0) * r
        current_d = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_d + (1.0 / 3.0) * current_k
        k_list.append(current_k)
        d_list.append(current_d)

    df['K'] = k_list
    df['D'] = d_list

    # 5. 價量累計圖預設值
    df['價量累計圖'] = 0

    return df

# ==========================================
# 【4. Discord Webhook 精美卡片推播模組】
# ==========================================

def send_discord_alert(stock_data, alert_type="BUY"):
    """
    發送精美 Discord Rich Embed 財務與技術面雙合一警報卡片
    """
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    # 依據警報類型設定顏色 (Buy = 亮綠藍色, Risk = 紅色)
    color = 0x00f2fe if alert_type == "BUY" else 0xff2a5f
    title_prefix = "🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵起步警報】" if alert_type == "BUY" else "⛈️🚨 【Zen AI 風控避險警報】"
    
    embed = {
        "title": f"{title_prefix} {stock_data['名稱']} ({stock_data['代號']})",
        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'),
        "color": color,
        "fields": [
            {
                "name": "📊 當前收盤價",
                "value": f"{stock_data['收盤價']} 元 ({stock_data['漲幅']}%)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "📈 60M KD值",
                "value": f"`{stock_data['K']} / {stock_data['D']}`",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🌀 週抗壓比 (MA60)",
                "value": f"{stock_data['週抗壓比']} (MA60: {stock_data['週MA60']})",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💰 FactSet 預估 EPS",
                "value": f"{stock_data['最新EPS']} 元 (F_PE: {stock_data['F_PE']}x)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🎯 共識目標價",
                "value": f"{stock_data['目標價']} 元",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🚀 潛在空間",
                "value": f"{stock_data['潛在空間']}%",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💡 戰術執行指引 (V7.0)",
                "value": stock_data['執行指引'],
                "inline": False
            }
        ],
        "footer": {
            "text": "Zen AI 戰情室 Pro V7.0 • 系統自動監控中",
            "icon_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png"
        },
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }
    
    payload = {
        "username": "Zen AI 戰場指揮官",
        "avatar_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png",
        "embeds": [embed]
    }
    
    try:
        res = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        if res.status_code in [200, 204]:
            print(f"   📢 [Discord] {stock_data['名稱']} 警報卡片推送成功！", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [Discord] 推送失敗: HTTP {res.status_code}", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ❌ [Discord] 推送異常: {e}", flush=True)

# ==========================================
# 【5. 單檔執行任務 (多線程併發對齊版)】
# ==========================================

def sync_single_stock(code, target_cols):
    # 1. 隨機防鎖延遲： staggered 請求，確保 100% 避開 yfinance 的 429 限制
    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))
    
    real_name = get_db_name(code)
    display_name = real_name if real_name else code
    
    max_retries = 3
    raw_df = pd.DataFrame()
    
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            ticker = yf.Ticker(f"{code}.TW")
            raw_df = ticker.history(period="3mo", interval="60m")
            if not raw_df.empty:
                break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 下載失敗: {str(e)}"
            time.sleep(5)
            
    if raw_df.empty:
        return f"⚠️ {code} ({display_name}) 無回傳數據"

    try:
        raw_df = raw_df.reset_index()
        local_time = raw_df['Datetime'].dt.tz_convert('Asia/Taipei')
        
        raw_df['日期'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        raw_df['時間'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        raw_df['開盤價'] = raw_df['Open']
        raw_df['最高價'] = raw_df['High']
        raw_df['最低價'] = raw_df['Low']
        raw_df['收盤價'] = raw_df['Close']
        raw_df['成交量'] = raw_df['Volume']
        raw_df['代號'] = code
        raw_df['名稱'] = display_name

        # 計算 19 項指標
        processed_df = calculate_indicators(raw_df)

        num_fields = [
            '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', '成交量', 
            'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
            'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
        ]
        for col in num_fields:
            processed_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(processed_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

        final_df = processed_df[target_cols].astype(object).where(pd.notnull(processed_df[target_cols]), None)
        data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

        close_p = float(processed_df['收盤價'].iloc[-1])

        # 寫入資料庫
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 拿掉舊版 RTRIM，確保 100% 吃到 [IX_Stock60M_代號_日期_時間] 索引
            cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
            
            placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(target_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(target_cols)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            
            cursor.executemany(insert_sql, data_to_insert)
            conn.commit()

        success_msg = f"✅ {code} ({display_name}) 成功寫入 {len(data_to_insert)} 筆數據。"

        # =======================================================
        # 🎯 核心自動化：在寫入成功的瞬間，即時偵測 60M 低檔黃金交叉
        # =======================================================
        if len(processed_df) >= 2:
            last_row = processed_df.iloc[-1]
            prev_row = processed_df.iloc[-2]
            
            curr_k, curr_d = float(last_row['K']), float(last_row['D'])
            prev_k, prev_d = float(prev_row['K']), float(prev_row['D'])
            
            # 判斷：前一根 K <= D，當前根 K > D，且 D <= 30.0 (低檔黃金交叉) [Operational Manual]
            if prev_k <= prev_d and curr_k > curr_d and curr_d <= 30.0:
                print(f"   🎯 【交叉確認】{code} ({display_name}) 觸發 60M 低檔黃金交叉！正在撈取機構估值...", flush=True)
                
                # 自動關聯主庫 (WeeklyMA60Snapshot 與 FactSetEstimates) [WeeklyMA60Snapshot, Database Architecture, Anue鉅亨網]
                weekly_ratio = 0
                weekly_ma60 = 0
                est_eps = "無"
                target_price = "無"
                f_pe = "無"
                potential_space = "無"
                news_url = "https://news.cnyes.com"
                
                try:
                    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
                        db_cursor = conn.cursor()
                        # 1. 獲取鎖死的週線 MA60 快照 [WeeklyMA60Snapshot]
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT 本週中心 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
                        w_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if w_row:
                            weekly_ma60 = float(w_row[0])
                            if weekly_ma60 > 0:
                                weekly_ratio = round(close_p / weekly_ma60, 2)
                                
                        # 2. 獲取 FactSet 分析師估值速報 [Anue鉅亨網]
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 最新EPS中位數, 預估目標價, 新聞網址 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 新聞日期 DESC", (code.strip(),))
                        f_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if f_row:
                            est_eps = float(f_row[0]) if f_row[0] else "無"
                            target_price = float(f_row[1]) if f_row[1] else "無"
                            news_url = f_row[2] if f_row[2] else "https://news.cnyes.com"
                            
                            if est_eps != "無" and est_eps > 0:
                                f_pe = round(close_p / est_eps, 1)
                            if target_price != "無" and target_price > 0:
                                potential_space = round(((target_price - close_p) / close_p) * 100, 1)
                except Exception as db_e:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ 讀取 [FactSetEstimates] 關聯數據失敗: {db_e}", flush=True)

                # 組合指揮官戰術指引 [Operational Manual]
                guide = f"💡 60M KD 低檔金叉確立 ({round(curr_k, 1)} / {round(curr_d, 1)})。"
                if weekly_ratio > 0:
                    guide += f" 週抗壓比為 {weekly_ratio}。"
                    if weekly_ratio < 1.0:
                        guide += " 股價處於週線扣抵下方歷史超跌區，具備高安全係數防守優勢。" [Operational Manual]
                if potential_space != "無" and isinstance(potential_space, (int, float)) and potential_space > 20:
                    guide += f" 機構目標價潛在空間達 {potential_space}% [Anue鉅亨網]！預估本益比僅 {f_pe} 倍，符合『自選 29 (伏兵)』二號進攻標準，下週密切監控 60M OSC 是否翻正！" [Operational Manual, AI 策略分組]
                
                # 發送精美 Discord Embed 卡片到手機
                discord_data = {
                    "代號": code,
                    "名稱": display_name,
                    "收盤價": close_p,
                    "漲幅": round(float(last_row['Close'] - prev_row['Close'])/prev_row['Close']*100, 2) if len(processed_df) >= 2 else 0,
                    "K": round(curr_k, 1),
                    "D": round(curr_d, 1),
                    "週MA60": weekly_ma60,
                    "週抗壓比": weekly_ratio,
                    "最新EPS": est_eps,
                    "F_PE": f_pe,
                    "目標價": target_price,
                    "潛在空間": potential_space,
                    "新聞網址": news_url,
                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                send_discord_alert(discord_data, alert_type="BUY")
                
        return success_msg

    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【6. 多線程主控程式】
# ==========================================

def main():
    target_cols = [
        '名稱', '代號', '日期', '時間', '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', 
        'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
        '價量累計圖', '成交量', 'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
    ]
    
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    start_time = time.time()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 60M 安全多線程數據指標同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)

    # 安全雙線程併發，兼顧速度與防阻擋
    max_workers = 2 
    
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(sync_single_stock, code, target_cols): code for code in stocks}
        
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result = future.result()
            print(result, flush=True)

    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"🏁 數據指標同步與黃金交叉偵測全部結束！總花費時間: {round((end_time - start_time)/60, 2)} 分鐘。", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python
import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import random
import re
import pyodbc
import requests
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "Stock60M"

# 採用 Windows 驗證 (免 sa 密碼)
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# 貼上您的 Discord Webhook 網址，用於即時發送黃金交叉警報
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/您的_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    """
    動態從資料庫取得追蹤標的。
    預設抓取 StockPersonality 中最高勝率 >= 80 的 124 檔金牌自選股。
    若資料庫讀取失敗則自動使用權值股作為安全備案。
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 跨庫讀取主庫的金牌股性清單
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取 StockPersonality 金牌清單，採用預設標的。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        # 安全備案清單
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408', '1319', '1476', '2603', '2618', '3034']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    """
    自 basicinfo 取得個股中文名稱
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 19 項技術指標 Pandas 高精度運算引擎】
# ==========================================

def calculate_indicators(df):
    """
    在記憶體中自行運算 19 項指標，與券商主流公式一致：
    - SMA (5, 10, 20, 35, 60, 120, 200, 240)
    - MA (5, 10)
    - MACD (12, 26, 9) -> DIF, MACD9, OSC
    - KD (9, 3, 3)
    """
    # 確保按時間升序排序以進行滾動計算
    df = df.sort_values('Datetime').reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['Close']

    # 1. 計算 SMA 均線群
    df['SMA5'] = close.rolling(window=5).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA10'] = close.rolling(window=10).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA20'] = close.rolling(window=20).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA35'] = close.rolling(window=35).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA60'] = close.rolling(window=60).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA120'] = close.rolling(window=120).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA200'] = close.rolling(window=200).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA240'] = close.rolling(window=240).mean().fillna(0)

    # 2. 對應傳統 MA5 / MA10
    df['MA5'] = df['SMA5']
    df['MA10'] = df['SMA10']

    # 3. 計算 MACD (12, 26, 9)
    ema12 = close.ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = close.ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    df['DIF'] = (ema12 - ema26).fillna(0)
    df['MACD9'] = df['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0)
    df['OSC'] = (df['DIF'] - df['MACD9']).fillna(0)

    # 4. 計算 KD (9, 3, 3) ➔ 台股標準算法
    df['L9'] = df['Low'].rolling(window=9).min()
    df['H9'] = df['High'].rolling(window=9).max()
    denom = df['H9'] - df['L9']
    # 避免分母為 0
    rsv = np.where(denom != 0, (close - df['L9']) / denom * 100, 50.0)

    k_list, d_list = [], []
    current_k, current_d = 50.0, 50.0
    for r in rsv:
        if pd.isna(r): r = 50.0
        current_k = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_k + (1.0 / 3.0) * r
        current_d = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_d + (1.0 / 3.0) * current_k
        k_list.append(current_k)
        d_list.append(current_d)

    df['K'] = k_list
    df['D'] = d_list

    # 5. 價量累計圖預設值
    df['價量累計圖'] = 0

    return df

# ==========================================
# 【4. Discord Webhook 精美卡片推播模組】
# ==========================================

def send_discord_alert(stock_data, alert_type="BUY"):
    """
    發送精美 Discord Rich Embed 財務與技術面雙合一警報卡片
    """
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    # 依據警報類型設定顏色 (Buy = 亮綠藍色, Risk = 紅色)
    color = 0x00f2fe if alert_type == "BUY" else 0xff2a5f
    title_prefix = "🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵起步警報】" if alert_type == "BUY" else "⛈️🚨 【Zen AI 風控避險警報】"
    
    embed = {
        "title": f"{title_prefix} {stock_data['名稱']} ({stock_data['代號']})",
        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'),
        "color": color,
        "fields": [
            {
                "name": "📊 當前收盤價",
                "value": f"{stock_data['收盤價']} 元 ({stock_data['漲幅']}%)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "📈 60M KD值",
                "value": f"`{stock_data['K']} / {stock_data['D']}`",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🌀 週抗壓比 (MA60)",
                "value": f"{stock_data['週抗壓比']} (MA60: {stock_data['週MA60']})",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💰 FactSet 預估 EPS",
                "value": f"{stock_data['最新EPS']} 元 (F_PE: {stock_data['F_PE']}x)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🎯 共識目標價",
                "value": f"{stock_data['目標價']} 元",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🚀 潛在空間",
                "value": f"{stock_data['潛在空間']}%",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💡 戰術執行指引 (V7.0)",
                "value": stock_data['執行指引'],
                "inline": False
            }
        ],
        "footer": {
            "text": "Zen AI 戰情室 Pro V7.0 • 系統自動監控中",
            "icon_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png"
        },
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }
    
    payload = {
        "username": "Zen AI 戰場指揮官",
        "avatar_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png",
        "embeds": [embed]
    }
    
    try:
        res = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        if res.status_code in [200, 204]:
            print(f"   📢 [Discord] {stock_data['名稱']} 警報卡片推送成功！", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [Discord] 推送失敗: HTTP {res.status_code}", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ❌ [Discord] 推送異常: {e}", flush=True)

# ==========================================
# 【5. 單檔執行任務 (多線程併發對齊版)】
# ==========================================

def sync_single_stock(code, target_cols):
    # 1. 隨機防鎖延遲： staggered 請求，確保 100% 避開 yfinance 的 429 限制
    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))
    
    real_name = get_db_name(code)
    display_name = real_name if real_name else code
    
    max_retries = 3
    raw_df = pd.DataFrame()
    
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            ticker = yf.Ticker(f"{code}.TW")
            raw_df = ticker.history(period="3mo", interval="60m")
            if not raw_df.empty:
                break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 下載失敗: {str(e)}"
            time.sleep(5)
            
    if raw_df.empty:
        return f"⚠️ {code} ({display_name}) 無回傳數據"

    try:
        raw_df = raw_df.reset_index()
        local_time = raw_df['Datetime'].dt.tz_convert('Asia/Taipei')
        
        raw_df['日期'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        raw_df['時間'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        raw_df['開盤價'] = raw_df['Open']
        raw_df['最高價'] = raw_df['High']
        raw_df['最低價'] = raw_df['Low']
        raw_df['收盤價'] = raw_df['Close']
        raw_df['成交量'] = raw_df['Volume']
        raw_df['代號'] = code
        raw_df['名稱'] = display_name

        # 計算 19 項指標
        processed_df = calculate_indicators(raw_df)

        num_fields = [
            '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', '成交量', 
            'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
            'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
        ]
        for col in num_fields:
            processed_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(processed_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

        final_df = processed_df[target_cols].astype(object).where(pd.notnull(processed_df[target_cols]), None)
        data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

        close_p = float(processed_df['收盤價'].iloc[-1])

        # 寫入資料庫
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 拿掉舊版 RTRIM，確保 100% 吃到 [IX_Stock60M_代號_日期_時間] 索引
            cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
            
            placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(target_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(target_cols)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            
            cursor.executemany(insert_sql, data_to_insert)
            conn.commit()

        success_msg = f"✅ {code} ({display_name}) 成功寫入 {len(data_to_insert)} 筆數據。"

        # =======================================================
        # 🎯 核心自動化：在寫入成功的瞬間，即時偵測 60M 低檔黃金交叉
        # =======================================================
        if len(processed_df) >= 2:
            last_row = processed_df.iloc[-1]
            prev_row = processed_df.iloc[-2]
            
            curr_k, curr_d = float(last_row['K']), float(last_row['D'])
            prev_k, prev_d = float(prev_row['K']), float(prev_row['D'])
            
            # 判斷：前一根 K <= D，當前根 K > D，且當前 D <= 30.0 (低檔黃金交叉)
            if prev_k <= prev_d and curr_k > curr_d and curr_d <= 30.0:
                print(f"   🎯 【交叉確認】{code} ({display_name}) 觸發 60M 低檔黃金交叉！正在撈取機構估值...", flush=True)
                
                # 自動關聯主庫 (WeeklyMA60Snapshot 與 FactSetEstimates)
                weekly_ratio = 0
                weekly_ma60 = 0
                est_eps = "無"
                target_price = "無"
                f_pe = "無"
                potential_space = "無"
                news_url = "https://news.cnyes.com"
                
                try:
                    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
                        db_cursor = conn.cursor()
                        # 1. 獲取鎖死的週線 MA60 快照
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT 本週中心 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
                        w_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if w_row:
                            weekly_ma60 = float(w_row[0])
                            if weekly_ma60 > 0:
                                weekly_ratio = round(close_p / weekly_ma60, 2)
                                
                        # 2. 獲取 FactSet 分析師估值速報
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 最新EPS中位數, 預估目標價, 新聞網址 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 新聞日期 DESC", (code.strip(),))
                        f_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if f_row:
                            est_eps = float(f_row[0]) if f_row[0] else "無"
                            target_price = float(f_row[1]) if f_row[1] else "無"
                            news_url = f_row[2] if f_row[2] else "https://news.cnyes.com"
                            
                            if est_eps != "無" and est_eps > 0:
                                f_pe = round(close_p / est_eps, 1)
                            if target_price != "無" and target_price > 0:
                                potential_space = round(((target_price - close_p) / close_p) * 100, 1)
                except Exception as db_e:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ 讀取 [FactSetEstimates] 關聯數據失敗: {db_e}", flush=True)

                # 組合指揮官戰術指引
                guide = f"💡 60M KD 低檔金叉確立 ({round(curr_k, 1)} / {round(curr_d, 1)})。"
                if weekly_ratio > 0:
                    guide += f" 週抗壓比為 {weekly_ratio}。"
                    if weekly_ratio < 1.0:
                        guide += " 股價處於週線扣抵下方歷史超跌區，具備高安全係數防守優勢。"
                if potential_space != "無" and isinstance(potential_space, (int, float)) and potential_space > 20:
                    guide += f" 機構目標價潛在空間達 {potential_space}%！預估本益比僅 {f_pe} 倍，符合『自選 29 (伏兵)』二號進攻標準，下週密切監控 60M OSC 是否翻正！"
                
                # 發送精美 Discord Embed 卡片到手機
                discord_data = {
                    "代號": code,
                    "名稱": display_name,
                    "收盤價": close_p,
                    "漲幅": round(float(last_row['Close'] - prev_row['Close'])/prev_row['Close']*100, 2) if len(processed_df) >= 2 else 0,
                    "K": round(curr_k, 1),
                    "D": round(curr_d, 1),
                    "週MA60": weekly_ma60,
                    "週抗壓比": weekly_ratio,
                    "最新EPS": est_eps,
                    "F_PE": f_pe,
                    "目標價": target_price,
                    "潛在空間": potential_space,
                    "新聞網址": news_url,
                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                send_discord_alert(discord_data, alert_type="BUY")
                
        return success_msg

    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【6. 多線程主控程式】
# ==========================================

def main():
    target_cols = [
        '名稱', '代號', '日期', '時間', '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', 
        'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
        '價量累計圖', '成交量', 'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
    ]
    
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    start_time = time.time()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 60M 安全多線程數據指標同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)

    # 安全雙線程併發，兼顧速度與防阻擋
    max_workers = 2 
    
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(sync_single_stock, code, target_cols): code for code in stocks}
        
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result = future.result()
            print(result, flush=True)

    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"🏁 數據指標同步與黃金交叉偵測全部結束！總花費時間: {round((end_time - start_time)/60, 2)} 分鐘。", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// 微調前面的解析函數，使其同時支援「點擊按鈕」與「雙擊整列」
async function analyzeRowData(triggerObj) {
    // 如果傳入的是按鈕，尋找 tr；如果雙擊傳入的就是 tr，則直接使用
    const row = (triggerObj.tagName === "TR") ? triggerObj : triggerObj.closest('tr');
    if (!row) return;

    const cells = row.getElementsByTagName('td');
    
    // 以下維持原有的解析與請求邏輯...
    const stockName = cells[0]?.innerText.trim() || "-";
    const stockCode = cells[1]?.innerText.trim() || "-";
    const price     = parseFloat(cells[2]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const ratio     = parseFloat(cells[10]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const estEps    = parseFloat(cells[12]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;
    const targetPrice = parseFloat(cells[14]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;

    document.getElementById('ai-meta-name').innerText = `${stockName} (${stockCode})`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-price').innerText = `${price} 元`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-ratio').innerText = `${ratio}`;
    document.getElementById('ai-meta-eps').innerText = estEps > 0 ? `${estEps} 元 (目標 ${targetPrice} 元)` : "暫無機構資料";

    openAIPanel();

    const promptText = `你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【${stockName}(${stockCode})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中現價：${price}元，週抗壓比為${ratio}。
2. 機構預估 EPS 中位數為 ${estEps > 0 ? estEps + '元' : '無資料'}，共識目標價為 ${targetPrice > 0 ? targetPrice + '元' : '無資料'}。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。`;

    const outputBox = document.getElementById('ai-output-box');
    outputBox.innerHTML = '正在連線本機 Qwen-1.5B 進行分析中...';

    try {
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                model: 'qwen2.5:1.5b',
                prompt: promptText,
                stream: true
            })
        });

        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Ollama 連線異常');
        
        outputBox.innerHTML = ''; 
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

        while (true) {
            const { value, done } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;

            const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
            const lines = chunk.split('\n');
            for (const line of lines) {
                if (line.trim() !== '') {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(line);
                    outputBox.innerHTML += parsed.response;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        outputBox.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #ef4444;">❌ 本地解盤連線失敗。請確認 Ollama 正在背景運行。</span>`;
    }
}

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    """
    執行 60M 低檔金叉篩選 (只取前 5 名)
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    結合 60M、週快照與 FactSet 估值，連線 Qwen-1.5B 解盤
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            # 組合 Qwen 1.5B 提示詞
            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】
# ==========================================

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    # 驗證 LINE 的安全性簽章
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text}")

    # 判斷一：是否為選股指令
    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 進行 SQL 查詢
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        # 主動將運算結果推回 LINE 視窗 (Push Message)
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    # 判斷二：個股查詢 (解盤 XXXX 或直接輸入 4 位數代號)
    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 連線 Ollama
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        # 推送解盤報告
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 本地運行在 5000 連接埠
    print("🤖 LINE 雙向 Webhook 服務已啟動...")
    app.run(port=5000)

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    """
    執行 60M 低檔金叉篩選 (只取前 5 名)
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    結合 60M、週快照與 FactSet 估值，連線 Qwen-1.5B 解盤
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            # 組合 Qwen 1.5B 提示詞
            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】
# ==========================================

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    # 驗證 LINE 的安全性簽章
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text}")

    # 判斷一：是否為選股指令
    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 進行 SQL 查詢
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        # 主動將運算結果推回 LINE 視窗 (Push Message)
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    # 判斷二：個股查詢 (解盤 XXXX 或直接輸入 4 位數代號)
    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 連線 Ollama
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        # 推送解盤報告
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 本地運行在 5000 連接埠
    print("🤖 LINE 雙向 Webhook 服務已啟動...")
    app.run(port=5000)

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】
# ==========================================

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text}")

    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("🤖 LINE 雙向 Webhook 服務已啟動...")
    app.run(port=5000)

    sql = """
