        M.名稱, M.代號, M.盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(M.盤中現價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】
# ==========================================

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    # 驗證 LINE 的安全性簽章
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text}")

    # 判斷一：是否為選股指令
    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 進行 SQL 查詢
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        # 主動將運算結果推回 LINE 視窗 (Push Message)
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    # 判斷二：個股查詢 (解盤 XXXX 或直接輸入 4 位數代號)
    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        # 連線 Ollama
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        # 推送解盤報告
        line_bot_api.push_message(event.source.user_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 本地運行在 5000 連接埠
    print("🤖 LINE 雙向 Webhook 服務已啟動...")
    app.run(port=5000)

# ==========================================
# 【優化：自動識別訊息來源 ID (支援個人、群組與臨時聊天室)】
# ==========================================
def get_source_id(event):
    """
    動態判斷訊息來源：若是群組就回群組，若是臨時聊天室就回聊天室，個人就回個人。
    徹底解決訊息分流在不同視窗的問題！
    """
    if event.source.type == 'group':
        return event.source.group_id
    elif event.source.type == 'room':
        return event.source.room_id
    return event.source.user_id

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.畫本週中心 || W.本週中心, 0), 2)
    """
    # 修正內部 JOIN 與別名對齊
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    """
    執行 60M 低檔金叉篩選 (只取前 5 名)
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

python
def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    修正版：結合 60M、週快照與 FactSet 估值，並由 basicinfo 獲取最新即時價
    """
    # 核心修正：
    # 1. 直接關聯 stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 讀取 B.成交價 作為盤中現價
    # 2. 限制 M.日期 必須為最新一天，徹底解決抓到歷史舊價格的 Bug
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, 
        F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
      AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = M.代號)
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"
### 🏁 修改後的預期： 修改存檔並重新執行後，不論是在 LINE 還是 Telegram 上查詢，台積電 (2330) 的價格將會立刻校準為正確的 `2,415` 元，而週抗壓比與後續的 AI 戰術報告也會基於這個正確的現價重新精確產出！感謝您發現了這個關鍵問題！

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import random
import re
import pyodbc
import requests
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "Stock60M"

# 採用 Windows 驗證 (免 sa 密碼)
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# 貼上您的 Discord Webhook 網址，用於即時發送黃金交叉警報
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/您的_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取 StockPersonality 金牌清單，採用預設標的。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408', '1319', '1476', '2603', '2618', '3034']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 19 項技術指標 Pandas 高精度運算引擎】
# ==========================================

def calculate_indicators(df):
    df = df.sort_values('Datetime').reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['Close']

    # 1. 計算 SMA 均線群
    df['SMA5'] = close.rolling(window=5).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA10'] = close.rolling(window=10).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA20'] = close.rolling(window=20).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA35'] = close.rolling(window=35).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA60'] = close.rolling(window=60).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA120'] = close.rolling(window=120).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA200'] = close.rolling(window=200).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA240'] = close.rolling(window=240).mean().fillna(0)

    # 2. 對應傳統 MA5 / MA10
    df['MA5'] = df['SMA5']
    df['MA10'] = df['SMA10']

    # 3. 計算 MACD
    ema12 = close.ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = close.ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    df['DIF'] = (ema12 - ema26).fillna(0)
    df['MACD9'] = df['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0)
    df['OSC'] = (df['DIF'] - df['MACD9']).fillna(0)

    # 4. 計算 KD
    df['L9'] = df['Low'].rolling(window=9).min()
    df['H9'] = df['High'].rolling(window=9).max()
    denom = df['H9'] - df['L9']
    rsv = np.where(denom != 0, (close - df['L9']) / denom * 100, 50.0)

    k_list, d_list = [], []
    current_k, current_d = 50.0, 50.0
    for r in rsv:
        if pd.isna(r): r = 50.0
        current_k = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_k + (1.0 / 3.0) * r
        current_d = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_d + (1.0 / 3.0) * current_k
        k_list.append(current_k)
        d_list.append(current_d)

    df['K'] = k_list
    df['D'] = d_list
    df['價量累計圖'] = 0

    return df

# ==========================================
# 【4. Discord Webhook 格式優化推播模組】
# ==========================================

def send_discord_alert(stock_data, alert_type="BUY"):
    """
    發送精美 Discord 卡片 (強制數值欄位格式化為小數後兩位，徹底解決長尾浮點數問題)
    """
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    color = 0x00f2fe if alert_type == "BUY" else 0xff2a5f
    title_prefix = "🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵起步警報】" if alert_type == "BUY" else "⛈️🚨 【Zen AI 風控避險警報】"
    
    # 【高強度格式化核心】：在發送前，強制將收盤價、估值與抗壓比轉換並限制為 :.2f 格式
    try:
        display_price = f"{float(stock_data['收盤價']):.2f} 元"
    except:
        display_price = f"{stock_data['收盤價']} 元"

    try:
        display_ma60 = f"{float(stock_data['週MA60']):.2f}" if stock_data['週MA60'] else "無"
    except:
        display_ma60 = str(stock_data['週MA60'])

    try:
        display_eps = f"{float(stock_data['最新EPS']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['最新EPS'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_eps = str(stock_data['最新EPS'])

    try:
        display_target = f"{float(stock_data['目標價']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['目標價'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_target = str(stock_data['目標價'])

    embed = {
        "title": f"{title_prefix} {stock_data['名稱']} ({stock_data['代號']})",
        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'),
        "color": color,
        "fields": [
            {
                "name": "📊 當前收盤價",
                "value": f"{display_price} ({stock_data['漲幅']}%)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "📈 60M KD值",
                "value": f"`{stock_data['K']} / {stock_data['D']}`",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🌀 週抗壓比 (MA60)",
                "value": f"{stock_data['週抗壓比']} (MA60: {display_ma60})",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💰 FactSet 預估 EPS",
                "value": f"{display_eps} (F_PE: {stock_data['F_PE']}x)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🎯 共識目標價",
                "value": f"{display_target}",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🚀 潛在空間",
                "value": f"{stock_data['潛在空間']}%",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💡 戰術執行指引 (V7.0)",
                "value": stock_data['執行指引'],
                "inline": False
            }
        ],
        "footer": {
            "text": "Zen AI 戰情室 Pro V7.0 • 系統自動監控中",
            "icon_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png"
        },
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }
    
    payload = {
        "username": "Zen AI 戰場指揮官",
        "avatar_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png",
        "embeds": [embed]
    }
    
    try:
        res = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        if res.status_code in [200, 204]:
            print(f"   📢 [Discord] {stock_data['名稱']} 警報卡片推送成功！", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [Discord] 推送失敗: HTTP {res.status_code}", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ❌ [Discord] 推送異常: {e}", flush=True)

# ==========================================
# 【5. 單檔執行任務 (多線程併發對齊版)】
# ==========================================

def sync_single_stock(code, target_cols):
    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))
    
    real_name = get_db_name(code)
    display_name = real_name if real_name else code
    
    max_retries = 3
    raw_df = pd.DataFrame()
    
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            ticker = yf.Ticker(f"{code}.TW")
            raw_df = ticker.history(period="3mo", interval="60m")
            if not raw_df.empty:
                break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 下載失敗: {str(e)}"
            time.sleep(5)
            
    if raw_df.empty:
        return f"⚠️ {code} ({display_name}) 無回傳數據"

    try:
        raw_df = raw_df.reset_index()
        local_time = raw_df['Datetime'].dt.tz_convert('Asia/Taipei')
        
        raw_df['日期'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        raw_df['時間'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        raw_df['開盤價'] = raw_df['Open']
        raw_df['最高價'] = raw_df['High']
        raw_df['最低價'] = raw_df['Low']
        raw_df['收盤價'] = raw_df['Close']
        raw_df['成交量'] = raw_df['Volume']
        raw_df['代號'] = code
        raw_df['名稱'] = display_name

        processed_df = calculate_indicators(raw_df)

        num_fields = [
            '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', '成交量', 
            'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
            'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
        ]
        for col in num_fields:
            processed_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(processed_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

        final_df = processed_df[target_cols].astype(object).where(pd.notnull(processed_df[target_cols]), None)
        data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

        close_p = float(processed_df['收盤價'].iloc[-1])

        # 寫入資料庫
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
            
            placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(target_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(target_cols)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            
            cursor.executemany(insert_sql, data_to_insert)
            conn.commit()

        success_msg = f"✅ {code} ({display_name}) 成功寫入 {len(data_to_insert)} 筆數據。"

        # =======================================================
        # 🎯 核心自動化：在寫入成功的瞬間，即時偵測 60M 低檔黃金交叉
        # =======================================================
        if len(processed_df) >= 2:
            last_row = processed_df.iloc[-1]
            prev_row = processed_df.iloc[-2]
            
            curr_k, curr_d = float(last_row['K']), float(last_row['D'])
            prev_k, prev_d = float(prev_row['K']), float(prev_row['D'])
            
            # 判斷：KD 低檔黃金交叉 [Operational Manual]
            if prev_k <= prev_d and curr_k > curr_d and curr_d <= 30.0:
                print(f"   🎯 【交叉確認】{code} ({display_name}) 觸發 60M 低檔黃金交叉！正在撈取機構估值...", flush=True)
                
                weekly_ratio = 0
                weekly_ma60 = 0
                est_eps = "無"
                target_price = "無"
                f_pe = "無"
                potential_space = "無"
                news_url = "https://news.cnyes.com"
                
                try:
                    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
                        db_cursor = conn.cursor()
                        # 1. 獲取週線 MA60 快照 [WeeklyMA60Snapshot]
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT 本週中心 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
                        w_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if w_row:
                            weekly_ma60 = float(w_row[0])
                            if weekly_ma60 > 0:
                                weekly_ratio = round(close_p / weekly_ma60, 2)
                                
                        # 2. 獲取 FactSet 分析師估值速報 [Anue鉅亨網]
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 最新EPS中位數, 預估目標價, 新聞網址 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 新聞日期 DESC", (code.strip(),))
                        f_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if f_row:
                            est_eps = float(f_row[0]) if f_row[0] else "無"
                            target_price = float(f_row[1]) if f_row[1] else "無"
                            news_url = f_row[2] if f_row[2] else "https://news.cnyes.com"
                            
                            if est_eps != "無" and est_eps > 0:
                                f_pe = round(close_p / est_eps, 1)
                            if target_price != "無" and target_price > 0:
                                potential_space = round(((target_price - close_p) / close_p) * 100, 1)
                except Exception as db_e:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ 讀取 [FactSetEstimates] 關聯數據失敗: {db_e}", flush=True)

                # 組合指揮官戰術指引 [Operational Manual]
                guide = f"💡 60M KD 低檔金叉確立 ({round(curr_k, 1)} / {round(curr_d, 1)})。"
                if weekly_ratio > 0:
                    guide += f" 週抗壓比為 {weekly_ratio}。"
                    if weekly_ratio < 1.0:
                        guide += " 股價處於週線扣抵下方歷史超跌區，具備高安全係數防守優勢。" [Operational Manual]
                if potential_space != "無" and isinstance(potential_space, (int, float)) and potential_space > 20:
                    guide += f" 機構目標價潛在空間達 {potential_space}% [Anue鉅亨網]！預估本益比僅 {f_pe} 倍，符合『自選 29 (伏兵)』二號進攻標準，下週密切監控 60M OSC 是否翻正！" [Operational Manual, AI 策略分組]
                
                # 發送精美 Discord Embed 卡片到手機
                discord_data = {
                    "代號": code,
                    "名稱": display_name,
                    "收盤價": close_p,
                    "漲幅": round(float(last_row['Close'] - prev_row['Close'])/prev_row['Close']*100, 2) if len(processed_df) >= 2 else 0,
                    "K": round(curr_k, 1),
                    "D": round(curr_d, 1),
                    "週MA60": weekly_ma60,
                    "週抗壓比": weekly_ratio,
                    "最新EPS": est_eps,
                    "F_PE": f_pe,
                    "目標價": target_price,
                    "潛在空間": potential_space,
                    "新聞網址": news_url,
                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                send_discord_alert(discord_data, alert_type="BUY")
                
        return success_msg

    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【6. 多線程主控程式】
# ==========================================

def main():
    target_cols = [
        '名稱', '代號', '日期', '時間', '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', 
        'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
        '價量累計圖', '成交量', 'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
    ]
    
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    start_time = time.time()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 60M 安全多線程數據指標同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)

    # 安全雙線程併發，兼顧速度與防阻擋
    max_workers = 2 
    
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(sync_single_stock, code, target_cols): code for code in stocks}
        
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result = future.result()
            print(result, flush=True)

    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"🏁 數據指標同步與黃金交叉偵測全部結束！總花費時間: {round((end_time - start_time)/60, 2)} 分鐘。", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import random
import re
import pyodbc
import requests
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "Stock60M"

# 使用本機 Windows 驗證連接
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# 貼上您的 Discord Webhook 網址，用於即時發送黃金交叉警報
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/您的_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    """
    動態從資料庫取得追蹤標的。
    預設抓取 StockPersonality 中最高勝率 >= 80 的 124 檔金牌自選股。
    若資料庫讀取失敗則自動使用權值股作為安全備案。
    """
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 跨庫讀取主庫的金牌股性清單
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取金牌清單，採用預設標的。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        # 安全備案清單
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408', '1319', '1476', '2603', '2618', '3034']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    """
    自 basicinfo 取得個股中文名稱
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 19 項技術指標 Pandas 高精度運算引擎】
# ==========================================

def calculate_indicators(df):
    """
    在記憶體中自行運算 19 項指標，與券商主流公式一致：
    - SMA (5, 10, 20, 35, 60, 120, 200, 240)
    - MA (5, 10)
    - MACD (12, 26, 9) -> DIF, MACD9, OSC
    - KD (9, 3, 3)
    """
    # 確保按時間升序排序以進行滾動計算
    df = df.sort_values('Datetime').reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['Close']

    # 1. 計算 SMA 均線群
    df['SMA5'] = close.rolling(window=5).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA10'] = close.rolling(window=10).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA20'] = close.rolling(window=20).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA35'] = close.rolling(window=35).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA60'] = close.rolling(window=60).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA120'] = close.rolling(window=120).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA200'] = close.rolling(window=200).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA240'] = close.rolling(window=240).mean().fillna(0)

    # 2. 對應傳統 MA5 / MA10
    df['MA5'] = df['SMA5']
    df['MA10'] = df['SMA10']

    # 3. 計算 MACD
    ema12 = close.ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = close.ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    df['DIF'] = (ema12 - ema26).fillna(0)
    df['MACD9'] = df['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0)
    df['OSC'] = (df['DIF'] - df['MACD9']).fillna(0)

    # 4. 計算 KD
    df['L9'] = df['Low'].rolling(window=9).min()
    df['H9'] = df['High'].rolling(window=9).max()
    denom = df['H9'] - df['L9']
    rsv = np.where(denom != 0, (close - df['L9']) / denom * 100, 50.0)

    k_list, d_list = [], []
    current_k, current_d = 50.0, 50.0
    for r in rsv:
        if pd.isna(r): r = 50.0
        current_k = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_k + (1.0 / 3.0) * r
        current_d = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_d + (1.0 / 3.0) * current_k
        k_list.append(current_k)
        d_list.append(current_d)

    df['K'] = k_list
    df['D'] = d_list
    df['價量累計圖'] = 0

    return df

# 【4. Discord Webhook 格式優化推播模組】
# ==========================================

def send_discord_alert(stock_data, alert_type="BUY"):
    """
    發送精美 Discord 卡片 (強制數值欄位格式化為小數後兩位，徹底解決長尾浮點數問題)
    """
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    color = 0x00f2fe if alert_type == "BUY" else 0xff2a5f
    title_prefix = "🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵起步警報】" if alert_type == "BUY" else "⛈️🚨 【Zen AI 風控避險警報】"
    
    # 強制將收盤價、估值與抗壓比轉換並限制為 :.2f 格式
    try:
        display_price = f"{float(stock_data['收盤價']):.2f} 元"
    except:
        display_price = f"{stock_data['收盤價']} 元"

    try:
        display_ma60 = f"{float(stock_data['週MA60']):.2f}" if stock_data['週MA60'] else "無"
    except:
        display_ma60 = str(stock_data['週MA60'])

    try:
        display_eps = f"{float(stock_data['最新EPS']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['最新EPS'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_eps = str(stock_data['最新EPS'])

    try:
        display_target = f"{float(stock_data['目標價']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['目標價'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_target = str(stock_data['目標價'])

    embed = {
        "title": f"{title_prefix} {stock_data['名稱']} ({stock_data['代號']})",
        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'),
        "color": color,
        "fields": [
            {
                "name": "📊 當前收盤價",
                "value": f"{display_price} ({stock_data['漲幅']}%)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "📈 60M KD值",
                "value": f"`{stock_data['K']} / {stock_data['D']}`",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🌀 週抗壓比 (MA60)",
                "value": f"{stock_data['週抗壓比']} (MA60: {display_ma60})",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💰 FactSet 預估 EPS",
                "value": f"{display_eps} (F_PE: {stock_data['F_PE']}x)",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🎯 共識目標價",
                "value": f"{display_target}",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "🚀 潛在空間",
                "value": f"{stock_data['潛在空間']}%",
                "inline": True
            },
            {
                "name": "💡 戰術執行指引 (V7.0)",
                "value": stock_data['執行指引'],
                "inline": False
            }
        ],
        "footer": {
            "text": "Zen AI 戰情室 Pro V7.0 • 系統自動監控中",
            "icon_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png"
        },
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }
    
    payload = {
        "username": "Zen AI 戰場指揮官",
        "avatar_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png",
        "embeds": [embed]
    }
    
    try:
        res = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        if res.status_code in [200, 204]:
            print(f"   📢 [Discord] {stock_data['名稱']} 警報卡片推送成功！", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [Discord] 推送失敗: HTTP {res.status_code}", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ❌ [Discord] 推送異常: {e}", flush=True)

# ==========================================
# 【5. 單檔執行任務 (多線程併發對齊版)】
# ==========================================

def sync_single_stock(code, target_cols):
    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))
    
    real_name = get_db_name(code)
    display_name = real_name if real_name else code
    
    max_retries = 3
    raw_df = pd.DataFrame()
    
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            ticker = yf.Ticker(f"{code}.TW")
            raw_df = ticker.history(period="3mo", interval="60m")
            if not raw_df.empty:
                break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 下載失敗: {str(e)}"
            time.sleep(5)
            
    if raw_df.empty:
        return f"⚠️ {code} ({display_name}) 無回傳數據"

    try:
        raw_df = raw_df.reset_index()
        local_time = raw_df['Datetime'].dt.tz_convert('Asia/Taipei')
        
        raw_df['日期'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        raw_df['時間'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        raw_df['開盤價'] = raw_df['Open']
        raw_df['最高價'] = raw_df['High']
        raw_df['最低價'] = raw_df['Low']
        raw_df['收盤價'] = raw_df['Close']
        raw_df['成交量'] = raw_df['Volume']
        raw_df['代號'] = code
        raw_df['名稱'] = display_name

        # 計算 19 項指標
        processed_df = calculate_indicators(raw_df)

        num_fields = [
            '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', '成交量', 
            'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
            'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
        ]
        for col in num_fields:
            processed_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(processed_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

        final_df = processed_df[target_cols].astype(object).where(pd.notnull(processed_df[target_cols]), None)
        data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

        close_p = float(processed_df['收盤價'].iloc[-1])

        # 寫入資料庫
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
            
            placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(target_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(target_cols)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            
            cursor.executemany(insert_sql, data_to_insert)
            conn.commit()

        success_msg = f"✅ {code} ({display_name}) 成功寫入 {len(data_to_insert)} 筆數據。"

        # =======================================================
        # 🎯 核心自動化：在寫入成功的瞬間，即時偵測 60M 低檔黃金交叉
        # =======================================================
        if len(processed_df) >= 2:
            last_row = processed_df.iloc[-1]
            prev_row = processed_df.iloc[-2]
            
            curr_k, curr_d = float(last_row['K']), float(last_row['D'])
            prev_k, prev_d = float(prev_row['K']), float(prev_row['D'])
            
            # 判斷：60M KD 指標是否處於低檔交叉
            if prev_k <= prev_d and curr_k > curr_d and curr_d <= 30.0:
                print(f"   🎯 【交叉確認】{code} ({display_name}) 觸發 60M 低檔黃金交叉！正在撈取機構估值...", flush=True)
                
                weekly_ratio = 0
                weekly_ma60 = 0
                est_eps = "無"
                target_price = "無"
                f_pe = "無"
                potential_space = "無"
                news_url = "https://news.cnyes.com"
                
                try:
                    with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
                        db_cursor = conn.cursor()
                        # 1. 獲取預先算好的週均線快照
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT 本週中心 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
                        w_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if w_row:
                            weekly_ma60 = float(w_row[0])
                            if weekly_ma60 > 0:
                                weekly_ratio = round(close_p / weekly_ma60, 2)
                                
                        # 2. 獲取 FactSet 分析師機構預測速報
                        db_cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 最新EPS中位數, 預估目標價, 新聞網址 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 新聞日期 DESC", (code.strip(),))
                        f_row = db_cursor.fetchone()
                        if f_row:
                            est_eps = float(f_row[0]) if f_row[0] else "無"
                            target_price = float(f_row[1]) if f_row[1] else "無"
                            news_url = f_row[2] if f_row[2] else "https://news.cnyes.com"
                            
                            if est_eps != "無" and est_eps > 0:
                                f_pe = round(close_p / est_eps, 1)
                            if target_price != "無" and target_price > 0:
                                potential_space = round(((target_price - close_p) / close_p) * 100, 1)
                except Exception as db_e:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ 讀取 [FactSetEstimates] 關聯數據失敗: {db_e}", flush=True)

                # 組合系統實戰指揮引導文字
                guide = f"💡 60M KD 低檔金叉確立 ({round(curr_k, 1)} / {round(curr_d, 1)})。"
                if weekly_ratio > 0:
                    guide += f" 週抗壓比為 {weekly_ratio}。"
                    if weekly_ratio < 1.0:
                        guide += " 價格目前低於週線扣抵，中長線基期低，具備相對安全的防守邊界。"
                if potential_space != "無" and isinstance(potential_space, (int, float)) and potential_space > 20:
                    guide += f" 機構目標價潛在空間達 {potential_space}%！預估本益比僅 {f_pe} 倍，滿足第29號自選股（伏兵策略）的二號進場要件，下週可密切注意 60M OSC 翻正指標。"
                
                # 發送精美 Discord Embed 卡片到手機
                discord_data = {
                    "代號": code,
                    "名稱": display_name,
                    "收盤價": close_p,
                    "漲幅": round(float(last_row['Close'] - prev_row['Close'])/prev_row['Close']*100, 2) if len(processed_df) >= 2 else 0,
                    "K": round(curr_k, 1),
                    "D": round(curr_d, 1),
                    "週MA60": weekly_ma60,
                    "週抗壓比": weekly_ratio,
                    "最新EPS": est_eps,
                    "F_PE": f_pe,
                    "目標價": target_price,
                    "潛在空間": potential_space,
                    "新聞網址": news_url,
                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                send_discord_alert(discord_data, alert_type="BUY")
                
        return success_msg

    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【6. 多線程主控程式】
# ==========================================

def main():
    target_cols = [
        '名稱', '代號', '日期', '時間', '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', 
        'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
        '價量累計圖', '成交量', 'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
    ]
    
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    start_time = time.time()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 60M 安全多線程數據指標同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)

    # 安全雙線程併發，兼顧速度與防阻擋
    max_workers = 2 
    
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(sync_single_stock, code, target_cols): code for code in stocks}
        
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result = future.result()
            print(result, flush=True)

    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"🏁 數據指標同步與黃金交叉偵測全部結束！總花費時間: {round((end_time - start_time)/60, 2)} 分鐘。", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import random
import pyodbc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import yfinance as yf
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
TARGET_TABLE = "Stock60M"

# 採用 Windows 本地驗證 (免 sa 密碼)
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 核心資料庫與清單處理】
# ==========================================

def get_target_stocks():
    stocks = []
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            query = "SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(代號) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality WHERE 最高勝率 >= 80"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            stocks = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0]]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 無法讀取金牌清單，採用預設標的。錯誤: {e}", flush=True)
        
    if not stocks:
        stocks = ['2454', '2330', '2317', '2327', '2408', '1319', '1476', '2603', '2618', '3034']
    return [s.strip() for s in stocks]

def get_db_name(stock_code):
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(名稱) FROM basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (stock_code.strip(),))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: return row[0]
    except: 
        return None
    return None

# ==========================================
# 【3. 19 項技術指標 Pandas 高精度運算引擎】
# ==========================================

def calculate_indicators(df):
    df = df.sort_values('Datetime').reset_index(drop=True)
    close = df['Close']

    df['SMA5'] = close.rolling(window=5).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA10'] = close.rolling(window=10).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA20'] = close.rolling(window=20).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA35'] = close.rolling(window=35).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA60'] = close.rolling(window=60).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA120'] = close.rolling(window=120).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA200'] = close.rolling(window=200).mean().fillna(0)
    df['SMA240'] = close.rolling(window=240).mean().fillna(0)

    df['MA5'] = df['SMA5']
    df['MA10'] = df['SMA10']

    ema12 = close.ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = close.ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    df['DIF'] = (ema12 - ema26).fillna(0)
    df['MACD9'] = df['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean().fillna(0)
    df['OSC'] = (df['DIF'] - df['MACD9']).fillna(0)

    df['L9'] = df['Low'].rolling(window=9).min()
    df['H9'] = df['High'].rolling(window=9).max()
    denom = df['H9'] - df['L9']
    rsv = np.where(denom != 0, (close - df['L9']) / denom * 100, 50.0)

    k_list, d_list = [], []
    current_k, current_d = 50.0, 50.0
    for r in rsv:
        if pd.isna(r): r = 50.0
        current_k = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_k + (1.0 / 3.0) * r
        current_d = (2.0 / 3.0) * current_d + (1.0 / 3.0) * current_k
        k_list.append(current_k)
        d_list.append(current_d)

    df['K'] = k_list
    df['D'] = d_list
    df['價量累計圖'] = 0

    return df

# ==========================================
# 【4. 單檔執行任務】
# ==========================================

def sync_single_stock(code, target_cols):
    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.5, 3.5))
    
    real_name = get_db_name(code)
    display_name = real_name if real_name else code
    
    max_retries = 3
    raw_df = pd.DataFrame()
    
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            ticker = yf.Ticker(f"{code}.TW")
            raw_df = ticker.history(period="3mo", interval="60m")
            if not raw_df.empty:
                break
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 下載失敗: {str(e)}"
            time.sleep(5)
            
    if raw_df.empty:
        return f"⚠️ {code} ({display_name}) 無回傳數據"

    try:
        raw_df = raw_df.reset_index()
        local_time = raw_df['Datetime'].dt.tz_convert('Asia/Taipei')
        
        raw_df['日期'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        raw_df['時間'] = local_time.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        raw_df['開盤價'] = raw_df['Open']
        raw_df['最高價'] = raw_df['High']
        raw_df['最低價'] = raw_df['Low']
        raw_df['收盤價'] = raw_df['Close']
        raw_df['成交量'] = raw_df['Volume']
        raw_df['代號'] = code
        raw_df['名稱'] = display_name

        processed_df = calculate_indicators(raw_df)

        num_fields = [
            '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', '成交量', 
            'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
            'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
        ]
        for col in num_fields:
            processed_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(processed_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

        final_df = processed_df[target_cols].astype(object).where(pd.notnull(processed_df[target_cols]), None)
        data_to_insert = final_df.values.tolist()

        # 寫入資料庫
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE 代號 = ?", (code.strip(),))
            
            placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(target_cols))
            insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({','.join(target_cols)}) VALUES ({placeholders})"
            
            cursor.executemany(insert_sql, data_to_insert)
            conn.commit()

        return f"✅ {code} ({display_name}) 成功寫入 {len(data_to_insert)} 筆數據。"

    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ {code} ({display_name}) 執行失敗: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【5. 主控流程】
# ==========================================

def main():
    target_cols = [
        '名稱', '代號', '日期', '時間', '開盤價', '最高價', '最低價', '收盤價', 
        'SMA5', 'SMA10', 'SMA20', 'SMA60', 'SMA120', 'SMA240', 'SMA35', 'SMA200', 
        '價量累計圖', '成交量', 'MA5', 'MA10', 'DIF', 'MACD9', 'OSC', 'K', 'D'
    ]
    
    stocks = get_target_stocks()
    start_time = time.time()
    print(f"🚀 開始執行 60M 安全多線程數據指標同步。目標標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔...", flush=True)

    max_workers = 2 
    
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(sync_single_stock, code, target_cols): code for code in stocks}
        
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            result = future.result()
            print(result, flush=True)

    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"🏁 數據指標同步全部結束！總花費時間: {round((end_time - start_time)/60, 2)} 分鐘。", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import requests
import pyodbc

# ==========================================
# 【1. 設定區】
# ==========================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchange"
DRIVER = "{SQL Server}"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={DRIVER};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# 請貼上純淨的 Discord 原始 Webhook 網址 (後面絕對不能有 /callback 或空格)
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/您的_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL'

# ==========================================
# 【2. 格式化與發送模組】
# ==========================================

def send_discord_alert(stock_data):
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    color = 0x00f2fe
    
    try:
        display_price = f"{float(stock_data['收盤價']):.2f} 元"
    except:
        display_price = f"{stock_data['收盤價']} 元"

    try:
        display_ma60 = f"{float(stock_data['週MA60']):.2f}" if stock_data['週MA60'] else "無"
    except:
        display_ma60 = str(stock_data['週MA60'])

    try:
        display_eps = f"{float(stock_data['最新EPS']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['最新EPS'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_eps = str(stock_data['最新EPS'])

    try:
        display_target = f"{float(stock_data['目標價']):.2f} 元" if isinstance(stock_data['目標價'], (int, float)) else "無"
    except:
        display_target = str(stock_data['目標價'])

    embed = {
        "title": f"🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵起步警報】 {stock_data['名稱']} ({stock_data['代號']})",
        "url": stock_data.get('新聞網址', 'https://news.cnyes.com'),
        "color": color,
        "fields": [
            {"name": "📊 當前收盤價", "value": f"{display_price} ({stock_data['漲幅']}%)", "inline": True},
            {"name": "📈 60M KD值", "value": f"`{stock_data['K']} / {stock_data['D']}`", "inline": True},
            {"name": "🌀 週抗壓比 (MA60)", "value": f"{stock_data['週抗壓比']} (MA60: {display_ma60})", "inline": True},
            {"name": "💰 FactSet 預估 EPS", "value": f"{display_eps} (F_PE: {stock_data['F_PE']}x)", "inline": True},
            {"name": "🎯 共識目標價", "value": f"{display_target}", "inline": True},
            {"name": "🚀 潛在空間", "value": f"{stock_data['潛在空間']}%", "inline": True},
            {"name": "💡 戰術執行指引 (V7.0)", "value": stock_data['執行指引'], "inline": False}
        ],
        "footer": {
            "text": "Zen AI 戰情室 Pro V7.0 • 系統自動監控中",
            "icon_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png"
        },
        "timestamp": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    }
    
    payload = {
        "username": "Zen AI 戰場指揮官",
        "avatar_url": "https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png",
        "embeds": [embed]
    }
    
    try:
        res = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=5)
        if res.status_code in [200, 204]:
            print(f"   📢 [Discord] {stock_data['名稱']} 警報卡片推送成功！")
        else:
            print(f"   ⚠️ [Discord] 推送失敗: HTTP {res.status_code}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   ❌ [Discord] 推送異常: {e}")

# ==========================================
# 【3. 核心選股與交叉運算】
# ==========================================

def run_alerts_check():
    # 利用與 excelsql2 一模一樣的扁平化 SELECT 優化版，精確找出當下金叉最強前 5 名
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比],
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價, F.新聞網址
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號) 
        AND F.新聞日期 = (SELECT MAX(新聞日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates WHERE 代號 = F.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    
    print("🔍 正在連線 SQL 進行黃金交叉掃描...")
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                print("ℹ️ 目前盤面暫無符合條件之標的。")
                return
                
            print(f"🎯 掃描完畢！共篩選出 {len(rows)} 檔符合條件之標的，開始推送至 Discord...")
            
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio, eps, target, news_url = r
                
                # 計算與組裝數據
                f_pe = "無"
                potential_space = "無"
                if eps and eps > 0:
                    f_pe = round(price / eps, 1)
                if target and target > 0:
                    potential_space = round(((target - price) / price) * 100, 1)
                    
                guide = f"💡 60M KD 低檔金叉確立 ({k} / {d})。"
                if ratio:
                    guide += f" 週抗壓比為 {ratio}。"
                    if ratio < 1.0:
                        guide += " 股價處於週線扣抵下方歷史超跌區，具備防守優勢。"
                if potential_space != "無" and potential_space > 20:
                    guide += f" 機構目標價潛在空間達 {potential_space}%！符合『自選 29 (伏兵)』二號進攻標準，下週密切監控 60M OSC 是否翻正！"

                stock_data = {
                    "代號": code,
                    "名稱": name,
                    "收盤價": price,
                    "漲幅": change,
                    "K": k,
                    "D": d,
                    "週MA60": ma60,
                    "週抗壓比": ratio,
                    "最新EPS": eps,
                    "F_PE": f_pe,
                    "目標價": target,
                    "潛在空間": potential_space,
                    "新聞網址": news_url if news_url else "https://news.cnyes.com",
                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                
                send_discord_alert(stock_data)
                time.sleep(1.0) # 發送延遲，避免 Discord 頻率限制
                
            print("🏁 警報推送任務結束。")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 掃描失敗: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_alerts_check()

def run_alerts_check():
    sql = """

        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,

        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比],
        F.最新EPS中位數, F.預估目標價, F.新聞網址
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,

            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)

    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """

                if potential_space != "無" and potential_space > 20:

                stock_data = {

                    "名稱": name,
                    "收盤價": price_f,
                    "漲幅": change_f,
                    "K": k_f,

                    "週MA60": ma60_f,

                    "執行指引": guide
                }
                
                send_discord_alert(stock_data)
                time.sleep(1.2) # 發送延遲，避免 Discord 頻率限制
                
            print("🏁 警報推送任務結束。")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 篩選失敗: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_alerts_check()

javascript
// =======================================================
// 【1. 系統級瀏覽器推播引擎 (HTML5 Notification API)】
// =======================================================

/**
 * 初始化並向使用者請求瀏覽器推播權限
 */
function initWebNotification() {
    if (!("Notification" in window)) {
        console.log("此瀏覽器不支援桌面系統級推播。");
        return;
    }
    // 若尚未授權，主動跳出瀏覽器視窗請求授權
    if (Notification.permission !== "granted" && Notification.permission !== "denied") {
        Notification.requestPermission().then(permission => {
            if (permission === "granted") {
                console.log("🎉 瀏覽器系統級推播權限已開通！");
            }
        });
    }
}

/**
 * 觸發 Windows 系統右下角的橫幅警報 (與解盤面板深度聯動)
 */
function triggerSystemNotification(stockName, stockCode, price, ratio, rowElement) {
    if (Notification.permission !== "granted") return;

    const title = `🟢☀️ 【Zen AI 伏兵發動】${stockName} (${stockCode})`;
    const options = {
        body: `盤中現價: ${price} 元 | 週抗壓比: ${ratio}\n已觸發 60M 低檔金叉，點此直接啟動 AI 深度解盤！`,
        icon: 'https://i.imgur.com/8Qp7ZpD.png', // 指揮官圖標
        requireInteraction: true,               // 保持在畫面上直到使用者點選或關閉
        silent: false                           // 播放系統預設提示音
    };

    const notification = new Notification(title, options);

    // 🎯 核心聯動：點擊通知時自動將網頁對焦 (Focus)，並直接滑出解盤面板進行 Qwen 運算！
    notification.onclick = function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        window.focus(); // 強制將瀏覽器分頁對焦到最前台
        
        if (rowElement) {
            console.log(`🎯 使用者點選推播通知，啟動 ${stockName} 本地 AI 運算...`);
            analyzeRowData(rowElement); // 調用先前寫好的雙擊/按鈕解盤函數
        }
        notification.close();
    };
}


// =======================================================
// 【2. 網頁端懸浮卡片引擎 (Toast Alerts)】
// =======================================================

/**
 * 動態在網頁右上方生成高質感的藍綠色懸浮警報卡片
 */
function showToastAlert(stockName, stockCode, price, ratio, rowElement) {
    // 建立卡片容器 (若不存在)
    let container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
    if (!container) {
        container = document.createElement('div');
        container.id = 'toast-container';
        container.style.position = 'fixed';
        container.style.top = '20px';
        container.style.right = '20px';
        container.style.zIndex = '9999';
        container.style.display = 'flex';
        container.style.flexDirection = 'column';
        container.style.gap = '10px';
        document.body.appendChild(container);
    }

    // 建立卡片 HTML 結構
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.style.background = '#111d2e';
    toast.style.border = '1px solid #00f2fe';
    toast.style.borderRadius = '8px';
    toast.style.padding = '15px';
    toast.style.width = '300px';
    toast.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 20px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.2)';
    toast.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    toast.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateX(50px)';
    
    toast.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">
            <strong style="color:#00f2fe; font-size:14px;">🟢☀️ Zen AI 伏兵警報</strong>
            <span style="color:#718096; font-size:12px;">剛剛</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; color:#e2e8f0; margin-bottom:5px;">
            ${stockName} (${stockCode})
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:13px; color:#cbd5e1; line-height:1.5;">
            現價: <span style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold;">${price}</span> 元 | 抗壓比: <span style="color:#f59e0b; font-weight:bold;">${ratio}</span>
            <br><span style="color:#718096; font-size:11px;">( 雙擊卡片或列，啟動 AI 運算 )</span>
        </div>
    `;

    container.appendChild(toast);

    // 動畫滑入效果
    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = '1';
        toast.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    }, 100);

    // 點擊卡片直接自動滑出解盤
    toast.addEventListener('dblclick', function() {
        if (rowElement) {
            analyzeRowData(rowElement);
        }
        toast.remove();
    });

    // 5 秒後自動滑出並消失
    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = '0';
        toast.style.transform = 'translateX(50px)';
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
    }, 5000);
}


// =======================================================
// 【3. 自動化掃描與觸發引擎 (Post-Load Scanner)】

/**
 * 每次 SQL 執行完畢、表格重新渲染後，主動調用此函數掃描整張 Table
 */
function scanTableForAlerts() {
    // 1. 初始化權限請求
    initWebNotification();

    // 2. 獲取表格中所有的數據列
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
    let alertCount = 0;

    rows.forEach(row => {
        const cells = row.getElementsByTagName('td');
        if (cells.length < 15) return; // 確保是一行完整的 excelsql2 數據

        // 3. 讀取對應欄位的數值 (請根據您網頁欄位實際 index 微調)
        const kVal = parseFloat(cells[7]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;     // 當前60M_K
        const dVal = parseFloat(cells[8]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;     // 當前60M_D
        const price = parseFloat(cells[2]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;    // 盤中現價
        const ratio = parseFloat(cells[10]?.innerText.trim()) || 0;   // 週抗壓比
        const name = cells[0]?.innerText.trim() || "";
        const code = cells[1]?.innerText.trim() || "";

        // 4. 實戰篩選條件：60M KD 低檔黃金交叉 (K > D 且 D <= 30) [Operational Manual]
        if (kVal > dVal && dVal <= 30.0 && price > 0) {
            // 🛠️ 標記防重複機制：避免每次自動整理表格時重複跳通知
            if (row.dataset.alerted !== "true") {
                row.dataset.alerted = "true"; // 標記為已通知過
                
                alertCount++;
                // 限制單次重新整理最多隻跳 3 個通知，防範洗板
                if (alertCount <= 3) {
                    // 同步觸發：系統橫幅通知 ＋ 網頁內懸浮卡片 [Operational Manual]
                    triggerSystemNotification(name, code, price, ratio, row);
                    showToastAlert(name, code, price, ratio, row);
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, 
        F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
      AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = M.代號)
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

def get_source_id(event):
    if event.source.type == 'group':
        return event.source.group_id
    elif event.source.type == 'room':
        return event.source.room_id
    return event.source.user_id

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    
    # 📢【核心亮點】：在背景終端機印出您的個人 LINE ID，以便您複製並填入最上方的 MY_LINE_USER_ID 中
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text} | 📢【取得您的個人 LINE ID】: {event.source.user_id}")

    reply_target_id = get_source_id(event)

    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        line_bot_api.push_message(reply_target_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        line_bot_api.push_message(reply_target_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

# ==========================================================
# 🛠️【新增 API 接口】：接收網頁端的推播指令，直接主動發送到您的手機 LINE
# ==========================================================
@app.route("/push_to_line", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def push_to_line_api():
    # 處理跨網域 CORS Preflight 請求
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        response = app.make_response('OK')
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'POST, OPTIONS'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type'
        return response

    try:
        data = request.json
        code = data.get('code', '').strip()
        
        if not code:
            return app.make_response(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "未收到股號參數"}, ensure_ascii=False))

        print(f"📲 收到網頁端一鍵推播請求！個股代號: {code}")
        
        # 1. 自動撈庫並呼叫 Qwen 產生解盤報告
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(code)
        
        # 2. 呼叫 LINE API 主動推送至您的手機
        if MY_LINE_USER_ID != '請貼上您的_U開談_LINE_USER_ID':
            line_bot_api.push_message(MY_LINE_USER_ID, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
            res_data = {"status": "success", "message": f"✅ 成功將 {code} 深度分析報告推播至您的 LINE 手機端！"}
        else:
            res_data = {"status": "warning", "message": "⚠️ 推播中斷：請先在 Python 的 MY_LINE_USER_ID 變數中貼上您的個人 LINE ID！"}
            
    except Exception as e:
        res_data = {"status": "error", "message": f"❌ 推播失敗: {str(e)}"}
        
    # 回傳 JSON 給網頁前端，並允許跨網域
    response = app.make_response(json.dumps(res_data, ensure_ascii=False))
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
    return response


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 強制監聽 0.0.0.0 (Port 5000)
    print("🤖 LINE 雙向 Webhook 服務已啟動...")
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)

/**
 * 實戰功能：將當前解盤標的一鍵推播至您的手機 LINE [Operational Manual]
 */
async function pushReportToLine() {
    // 1. 自動從面板中解析當前正在解盤的股票代號
    const metaNameText = document.getElementById('ai-meta-name').innerText; // 例如 "南亞科 (2408)"
    const stockCodeMatch = metaNameText.match(/\((\d{4})\)/);
    
    if (!stockCodeMatch) {
        alert("⚠️ 請先在表格上雙擊個股，開啟解盤面板後再進行推播！");
        return;
    }
    const stockCode = stockCodeMatch[1];
    
    // 2. 變更按鈕狀態為讀取中
    const btn = document.getElementById('push-line-btn');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = "⏳ 正在生成報告並推送至手機 LINE...";
    
    try {
        // 3. 直接向本機運行的 Flask API 發送推播指令
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/push_to_line', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ code: stockCode })
        });
        
        const resData = await response.json();
        alert(resData.message); // 跳出成功/失敗提示視窗
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        alert("❌ 連線中斷：請確認本機 line_ai_bot.py 程式正在運行，且 ngrok 隧道已開啟。");
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerText = "📲 一鍵推播解盤至手機 LINE";
    }
}

python
def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    防禦升級版：結合 60M、週快照與 FactSet 估值，並由 basicinfo 獲取最新即時價。
    採用 LEFT JOIN 進行防禦，確保即使快照表或 FactSet 暫時無數據，查詢也絕不中斷！
    """
    # 🛠️ 核心優化：將 WeeklyMA60Snapshot 與 FactSetEstimates 均改為 LEFT JOIN 進行防禦
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, 
        F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號) -- 改為 LEFT JOIN 防禦
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)  -- 改為 LEFT JOIN 防禦
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
      AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = ?) -- 精確參數化
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 傳入兩個 code 參數，精確對齊主查詢與子查詢
            cursor.execute(sql, (code.strip(), code.strip()))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD (加入 None 安全防護)
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code.strip(),))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if (kd_row and kd_row[0] is not None) else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if (kd_row and kd_row[1] is not None) else "無"

            # 處理 None 值 (防範 LEFT JOIN 出現空值時的顯示)
            ma60_val = f"{ma60:.2f}" if ma60 is not None else "無"
            ratio_val = f"{ratio}" if ratio is not None else "無"
            eps_val = f"{eps:.2f}" if (eps is not None and isinstance(eps, (int, float))) else "無"
            target_val = f"{target:.2f}" if (target is not None and isinstance(target, (int, float))) else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60_val}元，週抗壓比為{ratio_val}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps_val}元，目標價為 {target_val}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio_val} (MA60: {ma60_val})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps_val} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target_val} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"
