def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, 
        F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
      AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = M.代號)
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code,))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if kd_row else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if kd_row else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60}元，週抗壓比為{ratio}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps if eps else '無'}元，目標價為 {target if target else '無'}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps if eps else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target if target else '無'} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

# ==========================================
# 【3. LINE 簽章驗證與 Webhook 接收端】
# ==========================================

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

def get_source_id(event):
    if event.source.type == 'group':
        return event.source.group_id
    elif event.source.type == 'room':
        return event.source.room_id
    return event.source.user_id

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text} | 📢【取得您的個人 LINE ID】: {event.source.user_id}")

    reply_target_id = get_source_id(event)

    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        line_bot_api.push_message(reply_target_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."

def push_to_line_api():

        print(f"📲 收到網頁端一鍵 AI 解盤推播！個股: {code}")

        else:

    response = app.make_response(json.dumps(res_data, ensure_ascii=False))
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
    return response

# 🛠️【新 API 接口二】：接收網頁端的「量化數據卡片」並主動推播至 LINE (秒級抵達，不耗 AI 資源)
# ==========================================================
@app.route("/push_data_to_line", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def push_data_to_line_api():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        response = app.make_response('OK')
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'POST, OPTIONS'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type'
        return response

    try:
        data = request.json
        stock_name = data.get('name', '未知名')
        stock_code = data.get('code', '').strip()
        row_metrics = data.get('metrics', {}) # 接收網頁端動態抓取的所有欄位
        
        if not stock_code:
            return app.make_response(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "未收到股號"}, ensure_ascii=False))

        print(f"📲 收到網頁端「量化數據卡片」推播請求！標的: {stock_name} ({stock_code})")
        
        # 組合精緻格式化數據卡片
        msg = f"📊 <b>【Zen AI 量化實戰數據卡片】</b>\n"
        msg += f"<b>標的：{stock_name} ({stock_code})</b>\n"
        msg += f"────────────────\n"
        
        # 自動遍歷所有動態欄位
        for key, val in row_metrics.items():
            # 排除已在標題顯示過的名稱與代號
            if key not in ['名稱', '代號']:
                msg += f"• {key}：{val}\n"
                
        msg += f"────────────────\n"
        msg += f"<i>發送時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}</i>"
        
        # 呼叫 LINE 推送
        if MY_LINE_USER_ID != '請貼上您的_U開談_LINE_USER_ID':
            line_bot_api.push_message(MY_LINE_USER_ID, TextSendMessage(text=msg))
            res_data = {"status": "success", "message": f"✅ 成功將 {stock_name} 的實戰量化數據卡片推播至您的 LINE！"}
        else:
            res_data = {"status": "warning", "message": "⚠️ 推播中斷：請先在 Python 中設定您的個人 LINE ID！"}
            
    except Exception as e:
        res_data = {"status": "error", "message": f"❌ 推播失敗: {str(e)}"}
        
    response = app.make_response(json.dumps(res_data, ensure_ascii=False))
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
    return response

* 修改 B：在 `<script>` 標籤最下方，加入這個全新、功能強大且 100% 欄位自適應的 `pushDataCardToLine` 數據解析發送函數：
javascript
/**
 * 實戰功能：自動抓取當前 double-click 的所有欄位與數值，一鍵發送至 LINE [Operational Manual]
 */
async function pushDataCardToLine() {
    // 1. 讀取雙擊暫存的資料列
    const row = window.currentSelectedRow;
    if (!row) {
        alert("⚠️ 請先在表格上雙擊選中個股！");
        return;
    }

    // 2. 自動抓取表頭 (thead th) 與儲存格 (td)
    const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table thead th')).map(th => th.innerText.trim());
    const cells = Array.from(row.getElementsByTagName('td')).map(td => td.innerText.trim());

    if (headers.length === 0 || cells.length === 0) {
        alert("⚠️ 無法讀取表格結構，請確認 SQL 查詢是否已執行成功。");
        return;
    }

    // 3. 欄位動態配對
    const metrics = {};
    let stockName = "";
    let stockCode = "";

    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        const value = cells[index] || "";
        if (header === "名稱") stockName = value;
        if (header === "代號") stockCode = value;
        
        // 排除一些不必要推播的空欄位與序號
        if (header && value && header !== "自動編號" && header !== "AI 診斷") {
            metrics[header] = value;
        }
    });

    const btn = document.getElementById('push-data-line-btn');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = "⏳ 正在包裝量化數據並推送中...";

    try {
        // 4. 發送請求給本機 Python 後端 API
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/push_data_to_line', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                name: stockName,
                code: stockCode,
                metrics: metrics
            })
        });
        const resData = await response.json();
        alert(resData.message); // 提示推播結果
    } catch (error) {
        alert("❌ 連線失敗，請確認本機 line_ai_bot.py 正在運行，且 ngrok 已經啟動。");
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerText = "📊 一鍵推播「量化數據卡片」至手機 LINE";
    }
}

// =======================================================
// 【1. 核心優化：全自動全域資料列捕獲器】
//   不論您是用點擊、雙擊還是按鈕，只要觸發到表格列，自動在背景鎖定該行！

});

document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
    const tr = event.target.closest("tr");
    if (tr && !tr.querySelector("th")) {

// 【2. 一鍵推播「量化數據卡片」至 LINE 主函數 (高相容、抗卡死優化版)】
// =======================================================
async function pushDataCardToLine() {
    // 1. 讀取全自動捕獲的資料列
    let row = window.currentSelectedRow;
    
    // 防線：如果因為極端情況未捕獲到，主動嘗試去右側面板或當前畫面中抓取
    if (!row) {
        const activeRows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
        // 尋找剛剛被雙擊亮顯或點擊過的行 (或是預設抓第一行)
        if (activeRows.length > 0) {
            row = activeRows[0]; 
            window.currentSelectedRow = row;
        }
    }

    if (!row) {
        alert("⚠️ 系統未能自動鎖定行，請先在左側表格中「單擊」或「雙擊」選中您要推播的股票！");
        return;
    }

    // 2. 自動定位該列所屬的 Table，精確抓取表頭 (th) 與數值 (td)
    const table = row.closest('table');
    if (!table) {
        alert("⚠️ 無法定位表格結構！");
        return;
    }

    const headers = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.innerText.trim());
    const cells = Array.from(row.getElementsByTagName('td')).map(td => td.innerText.trim());

    if (headers.length === 0 || cells.length === 0) {
        alert("⚠️ 數據讀取不完整，請確認表格中是否已有資料。");
        return;
    }

    // 3. 欄位鍵值對動態組裝
    const metrics = {};
    let stockName = "";
    let stockCode = "";

    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        const value = cells[index] || "";
        if (header === "名稱") stockName = value;
        if (header === "代號") stockCode = value;
        
        // 過濾多餘無用的系統欄位或空值
        if (header && value && header !== "自動編號" && header !== "AI 診斷" && header !== "解盤") {
            metrics[header] = value;
        }
    });

    // 備用防線：如果 header 沒有名稱，嘗試從右側面板的 Meta 中強制讀取
    if (!stockName) {
        const metaNameText = document.getElementById('ai-meta-name')?.innerText || "";
        const match = metaNameText.match(/^(.+?)\s*\((\d{4})\)/);
        if (match) {
            stockName = match[1];
            stockCode = match[2];
        }
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('push-data-line-btn');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = "⏳ 正在包裝量化數據並推送中...";

    try {
        // 4. 發送請求給本機 Python 後端 API
        const response = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/push_data_to_line', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                name: stockName,
                code: stockCode,
                metrics: metrics
            })
        });
        const resData = await response.json();
        alert(resData.message); // 提示結果
    } catch (error) {
        alert("❌ 連線失敗，請確認本機 line_ai_bot.py 正在運行，且 ngrok 已經啟動。");
    } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerText = "📊 一鍵推播「量化數據卡片」至手機 LINE";
    }
}

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    """
    執行 60M 低檔金叉篩選 (只取前 5 名)
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 5
        L.代號, L.名稱, L.最新收盤 AS 盤中現價, B.漲幅, B.總量,
        ROUND(L.Curr_K, 1) AS K, ROUND(L.Curr_D, 1) AS D,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(L.最新收盤 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            R1.代號, R1.名稱, R1.收盤價 AS 最新收盤,
            R1.K AS Curr_K, R1.D AS Curr_D, R2.K AS Prev_K, R2.D AS Prev_D
        FROM (
            SELECT 代號, 名稱, 收盤價, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 代號, K, D,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC) AS Rn
            FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M
        ) R2 ON R1.代號 = R2.代號 AND R2.Rn = 2
        WHERE R1.Rn = 1
    ) AS L
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(L.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    WHERE L.Prev_K <= L.Prev_D AND L.Curr_K > L.Curr_D AND L.Curr_D <= 30.0 AND B.總量 >= 500
    ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                return "ℹ️ 目前盤面上暫無符合『60M KD 低檔金叉 ＋ 今日總量 > 500張』的股票。"
                
            msg = "📊 Zen AI 60M 低檔金叉選股結果：\n"
            msg += "────────────────\n"
            for r in rows:
                code, name, price, change, vol, k, d, ma60, ratio = r
                msg += f"■ {name} ({code})\n"
                msg += f" ├ 價格：{price} 元 ({change}%)\n"
                msg += f" ├ 成交量：{vol} 張\n"
                msg += f" ├ 60M KD：{k} / {d}\n"
                msg += f" └ 週抗壓比：{ratio} (MA60: {ma60})\n\n"
            msg += f"運算時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}"
            return msg
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 資料庫查詢失敗: {str(e)}"

def query_and_ai_analyze(code):
    """
    防禦升級版：結合 60M、週快照與 FactSet 估值，並由 basicinfo 獲取最新即時價。
    採用 LEFT JOIN 進行防禦，確保即使快照表或 FactSet 暫時無數據，查詢也絕不中斷！
    """
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中現價,
        F.最新EPS中位數, 
        F.預估目標價,
        W.本週中心 AS 週MA60,
        ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比]
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.FactSetEstimates F ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(F.代號)
    WHERE M.代號 = ?
      AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = ?)
    ORDER BY F.新聞日期 DESC
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (code.strip(), code.strip()))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return f"ℹ️ 資料庫中目前無 {code} 的對齊數據。"
                
            name, st_code, price, eps, target, ma60, ratio = row
            
            # 取得 60M KD (加入 None 安全防護)
            cursor.execute("SELECT TOP 1 K, D FROM stockchange.dbo.Stock60M WHERE 代號 = ? ORDER BY 日期 DESC, 時間 DESC", (code.strip(),))
            kd_row = cursor.fetchone()
            k_val = round(kd_row[0], 2) if (kd_row and kd_row[0] is not None) else "無"
            d_val = round(kd_row[1], 2) if (kd_row and kd_row[1] is not None) else "無"

            # 處理 None 值 (防範 LEFT JOIN 出現空值時的顯示)
            ma60_val = f"{ma60:.2f}" if ma60 is not None else "無"
            ratio_val = f"{ratio}" if ratio is not None else "無"
            eps_val = f"{eps:.2f}" if (eps is not None and isinstance(eps, (int, float))) else "無"
            target_val = f"{target:.2f}" if (target is not None and isinstance(target, (int, float))) else "無"

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深的台股量化操盤專家。請根據以下數據，為【{name}({st_code})】進行簡短且具體客觀的「60M伏兵戰術解盤」：
1. 盤中價：{price}元，週MA60：{ma60_val}元，週抗壓比為{ratio_val}。
2. 60M 級別 KD (K:{k_val}, D:{d_val})。
3. 最新 FactSet 分析師預估 2026 年 EPS 中位數為 {eps_val}元，目標價為 {target_val}元。
請針對下週一開盤給出「進攻防守點」與「本金凱利部位」配置建議。
請務必全部使用繁體中文回覆。"""

            # 呼叫 Ollama API
            ollama_url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            payload = {
                "model": "qwen2.5:1.5b",
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False
            }
            
            ai_res = requests.post(ollama_url, json=payload, timeout=20)
            ai_text = ai_res.json().get("response", "⚠️ 本地 AI 回傳格式異常。")

            msg = f"🤖 Zen AI 戰術解盤 [{name} ({st_code})]\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"盤中現價：{price} 元\n"
            msg += f"週抗壓比：{ratio_val} (MA60: {ma60_val})\n"
            msg += f"60M KD值：{k_val} / {d_val}\n"
            msg += f"分析師預估 EPS：{eps_val} 元\n"
            msg += f"共識目標價：{target_val} 元\n"
            msg += f"────────────────\n"
            msg += f"💡 戰術報告：\n{ai_text}\n\n"
            msg += f"解盤時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%m/%d %H:%M')}"
            return msg
            
    except Exception as e:
        return f"❌ 運作時發生非預期錯誤: {str(e)}"

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers['X-Line-Signature']
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

def get_source_id(event):
    """
    動態判斷訊息來源：若是群組就回群組，若是臨時聊天室就回聊天室，個人就回個人。
    徹底解決訊息分流在不同視窗的問題！
    """
    if event.source.type == 'group':
        return event.source.group_id
    elif event.source.type == 'room':
        return event.source.room_id
    return event.source.user_id

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_message(event):
    user_text = event.message.text.strip()
    
    # 在背景終端機印出您的個人 LINE ID，以便您複製並填入最上方的 MY_LINE_USER_ID 中
    print(f"📥 收到 LINE 訊息: {user_text} | 📢【取得您的個人 LINE ID】: {event.source.user_id}")

    reply_target_id = get_source_id(event)

    # 判斷一：是否為選股指令
    if any(kw in user_text for kw in ["金叉", "交叉", "選股", "找股票"]):
        reply_msg = "🔍 正在為您連線本地資料庫，執行 60M KD 低檔交叉篩選..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        result = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        line_bot_api.push_message(reply_target_id, TextSendMessage(text=result))
        return

    # 判斷二：個股查詢 (解盤 XXXX 或直接輸入 4 位數代號)
    stock_code = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, user_text))
    if len(stock_code) == 4:
        reply_msg = f"🔍 正在為您連線本機 Qwen-1.5B，進行 {stock_code} 深度分析中，請稍候..."
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=reply_msg))
        
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(stock_code)
        line_bot_api.push_message(reply_target_id, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
    else:
        welcome_text = "💡 您好！我是 Zen AI 智能操盤助理。\n\n"
        welcome_text += "您可以直接傳送：\n"
        welcome_text += "1. 股票代號（如 2408）➔ 執行 AI 技術與 FactSet 估值解盤\n"
        welcome_text += "2. 關鍵字「選股」➔ 執行 60M KD 低檔交叉選股"
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=welcome_text))

@app.route("/push_to_line", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def push_to_line_api():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        response = app.make_response('OK')
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'POST, OPTIONS'
        response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type'
        return response

    try:
        data = request.json
        code = data.get('code', '').strip()
        
        if not code:
            return app.make_response(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "未收到股號參數"}, ensure_ascii=False))

        print(f"📲 收到網頁端一鍵 AI 解盤推播！個股: {code}")
        ai_report = query_and_ai_analyze(code)
        
        if MY_LINE_USER_ID != '請貼上您的_U開談_LINE_USER_ID':
            line_bot_api.push_message(MY_LINE_USER_ID, TextSendMessage(text=ai_report))
            res_data = {"status": "success", "message": f"✅ 成功將 {code} 深度 AI 解盤報告推播至您的手機 LINE！"}
        else:
            res_data = {"status": "warning", "message": "⚠️ 推播中斷：請先設定 Python 中的 MY_LINE_USER_ID！"}
            
    except Exception as e:
        res_data = {"status": "error", "message": f"❌ 推播失敗: {str(e)}"}
        
    response = app.make_response(json.dumps(res_data, ensure_ascii=False))
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
    return response

/* 戰術二：【動能初發 (15~30分) ＋ 股性 DNA 時間收割】選股策略 */
SELECT
    T.名稱, 
    T.代號, 
    T.盤中成交價, 
    T.盤中漲幅, 
    T.盤中總量, 
    T.專家實戰總分,  -- 鎖定 15 ~ 30 分的動能初發標的

    -- --- 🏆 核心新增：股性 DNA 最佳持有期與賣點指引 ---
    T.[最高勝率(%)] AS [歷史最高勝率(%)],
    T.[最高勝率天數] AS [最佳持有天數(時間止盈)], -- 達到此天數，即可考慮分批收割
    T.[最大報酬天數] AS [最大報酬持有天數],

    -- --- 週線 MA60 快照與抗壓比 ---
    'P:' + CAST(CAST(W.前1週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) +
    ' >【' + CAST(CAST(W.本週中心 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + '】> ' +
    CAST(CAST(W.後1週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) + ' > ' +
    CAST(CAST(W.後2週 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS VARCHAR) AS [週MA60扣抵窗口],

    -- --- 戰略診斷 (已加入 3% 降幅梯度化判定) ---
    (CASE
        WHEN T.昨成交價 > V.W_Max THEN N'🟢☀️ 脫離引力 (全數過關)'
        WHEN T.昨成交價 * 1.05 > V.W_Max THEN N'🟡⚡ 準備翻轉 (5%過關)'
        WHEN W.本週中心 > W.後2週 AND ((W.本週中心 - W.後2週) / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0)) >= 0.03

        WHEN W.本週中心 > W.後2週

        ELSE N'🔴⛈️ 扣高重壓'
    END) AS [長線戰略狀態],

    ROUND(T.昨成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比],
    T.具體概念

FROM (
    -- 第一層：日線寬表與即時庫 JOIN 運算 (請確認您 StockPersonality 對應的欄位名稱)
    SELECT
        M.名稱, 
        M.代號, 
        B.成交價 AS 盤中成交價, 
        B.漲幅 AS 盤中漲幅, 
        B.總量 AS 盤中總量, 
        M.盤中現價 AS 昨成交價, 
        M.專家實戰總分, -- 讀取總分
        M.日期, 
        M.具體概念,
        P.最高勝率 AS [最高勝率(%)],
        -- 💡 讀取股性 DNA 1-30天回測的精確天數 (若您的欄位名稱不同，請對齊修改)
        P.最高勝率天數, 
        P.最大報酬天數
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
    INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality P ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P.代號)
    INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo AS B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    -- 篩選 A：鎖定金牌股性
    WHERE P.最高勝率 >= 80 
      -- 篩選 B：核心優化！專家分數在 15 ~ 30 分之間 (剛發動，未過熱)
      AND M.專家實戰總分 BETWEEN 15.0 AND 30.0 
) AS T

-- 2. 關聯週線 MA60 快照
INNER JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(T.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)

-- 3. 計算週線窗口最大值 (W_Max)
CROSS APPLY (

ORDER BY T.盤中總量 DESC;

    [最大報酬天數] INT NULL,                     -- S15 最大報酬天數
    [更新時間] DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_StockPersonality_S15] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([代號] ASC)
);

#### 步驟二：如何跑 15 分的回測？ 您原本用來跑 `StockPersonality` 的回測程式（不論是 Python 還是 SQL 預儲程序） [Database Architecture]，其 「進場觸發條件（Trigger）」 請進行以下修改： * 原 S30 觸發條件：`WHERE 今天分數 >= 30 AND 昨天分數 < 30` [Operational Manual] * 新 S15 觸發條件：`WHERE 今天分數 >= 15 AND 昨天分數 < 15` [Operational Manual] 跑完並寫入 `StockPersonality_S15` 後，您就擁有了兩套獨立、雙維度的個股 DNA 基因庫！ --- ### 📊 步驟三：在 `excelsql2` 中實現「雙 DNA 交叉比對」選股 現在，我們可以在 `excelsql2.html` 中，執行以下這段超強悍的雙對齊查詢 [Operational Manual]。 它會直接將目前處於 15~25 分發動區的股票 [Operational Manual]，同時拉出「15分起漲點 DNA」與「30分噴發點 DNA」在右側並排比對。您可以直接看出這檔標的是否具備「長短皆宜」的雙共振特質：
sql
/* 終極交叉比對：動態發動點 (15~25分) ＋ 雙維度股性 DNA 交叉驗證 */
SELECT 
    M.名稱, 
    M.代號, 
    B.成交價 AS [盤中現價], 
    M.專家實戰總分 AS [當前總分],
    
    -- 🟢 15分（伏兵起漲點）DNA 數據
    P15.最高勝率 AS [S15_最佳勝率(%)],
    P15.最高勝率天數 AS [S15_最佳持股天數(天)],
    P15.最大平均報酬 AS [S15_預期報酬(%)],
    
    -- 🟡 30分（強勢噴發點）DNA 數據
    P30.最高勝率 AS [S30_最佳勝率(%)],
    P30.最高勝率天數 AS [S30_最佳持股天數(天)],
    P30.最大平均報酬 AS [S30_預期報酬(%)],
    
    W.本週中心 AS [週MA60扣抵],
    ROUND(B.成交價 / NULLIF(W.本週中心, 0), 2) AS [週抗壓比],
    M.具體概念
FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis M
INNER JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.WeeklyMA60Snapshot W ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(W.代號)

-- 同時 LEFT JOIN 兩個不同訊號維度（15分與30分）的 1~30 天股性回測表
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_S15 P15 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P15.代號)
LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality P30 ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(P30.代號) -- 預設的 S30 表

-- 鎖定最新一天的數據，且當前分數剛好處於動能初發的黃金區間
WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = M.代號)
  AND M.專家實戰總分 BETWEEN 15.0 AND 25.0
ORDER BY B.總量 DESC;

USE [stockchangedate];

-- =========================================================================
-- Stored Procedure Name: [dbo].[sp_UpdateStockPersonality_S15]
-- Description: 針對「專家實戰總分 >= 15」的伏兵訊號，自動進行 1~30 天持有期回測，
--              找出每檔個股在起漲點下的「最高勝率天數」與「最大平均報酬率天數」，
--              並精確寫入/更新 [StockPersonality_S15] 數據庫中。
-- =========================================================================
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_UpdateStockPersonality_S15]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立「全歷史日線價格與 1~30 天未來價格對照」臨時表
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RawFuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #RawFuturePrices;

    SELECT 
        代號, 日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        LAG(專家實戰總分, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Prev_Score,
        -- 使用 LEAD 函數獲取未來第 1 天至第 30 天的收盤現價
        LEAD(盤中現價, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T1,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T2,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T3,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 4) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T4,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 5) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T5,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 6) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T6,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 7) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T7,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 8) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T8,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 9) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T9,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 10) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T10,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 11) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T11,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 12) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T12,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 13) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T13,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 14) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T14,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 15) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T15,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 16) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T16,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 17) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T17,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 18) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T18,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 19) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T19,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 20) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T20,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 21) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T21,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 22) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T22,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 23) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T23,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 24) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T24,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 25) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T25,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 26) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T26,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 27) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T27,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 28) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T28,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 29) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T29,
        LEAD(盤中現價, 30) OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期) AS Price_T30
    FROM dbo.MasterStockAnalysis;

    -- 2. 篩選出符合「實戰總分首度突破 >= 15 分 (起漲點)」的進場歷史訊號
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;

    SELECT 
        代號, 日期, 盤中現價,
        -- 計算 T+1 天至 T+30 天的相對報酬率
        (Price_T1 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T1,
        (Price_T2 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T2,
        (Price_T3 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T3,
        (Price_T4 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T4,
        (Price_T5 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T5,
        (Price_T6 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T6,
        (Price_T7 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T7,
        (Price_T8 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T8,
        (Price_T9 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T9,
        (Price_T10 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T10,
        (Price_T11 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T11,
        (Price_T12 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T12,
        (Price_T13 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T13,
        (Price_T14 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T14,
        (Price_T15 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T15,
        (Price_T16 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T16,
        (Price_T17 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T17,
        (Price_T18 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T18,
        (Price_T19 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T19,
        (Price_T20 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T20,
        (Price_T21 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T21,
        (Price_T22 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T22,
        (Price_T23 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T23,
        (Price_T24 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T24,
        (Price_T25 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T25,
        (Price_T26 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T26,
        (Price_T27 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T27,
        (Price_T28 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T28,
        (Price_T29 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T29,
        (Price_T30 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T30
    INTO #TriggerReturns
    FROM #RawFuturePrices
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 >= 15.0 AND (Prev_Score < 15.0 OR Prev_Score IS NULL);

    -- 3. 利用 CROSS APPLY 將 1~30 天欄位進行橫向轉置 (Unpivot)，快速計算各持有期的勝率與平均報酬
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MetricsByHoldDays') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MetricsByHoldDays;

    SELECT 
        代號, 
        Hold_Days,
        AVG(Ret) AS Avg_Return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) / COUNT(*) AS Win_Rate
    INTO #MetricsByHoldDays
    FROM #TriggerReturns
    CROSS APPLY (
        VALUES 
        (1, Ret_T1), (2, Ret_T2), (3, Ret_T3), (4, Ret_T4), (5, Ret_T5),
        (6, Ret_T6), (7, Ret_T7), (8, Ret_T8), (9, Ret_T9), (10, Ret_T10),
        (11, Ret_T11), (12, Ret_T12), (13, Ret_T13), (14, Ret_T14), (15, Ret_T15),
        (16, Ret_T16), (17, Ret_T17), (18, Ret_T18), (19, Ret_T19), (20, Ret_T20),
        (21, Ret_T21), (22, Ret_T22), (23, Ret_T23), (24, Ret_T24), (25, Ret_T25),
        (26, Ret_T26), (27, Ret_T27), (28, Ret_T28), (29, Ret_T29), (30, Ret_T30)
    ) AS V(Hold_Days, Ret)
    GROUP BY 代號, Hold_Days;

    -- 4. 找出每檔股票勝率最高、以及平均報酬率最高的最佳持有天數 (採用 CTE 與 ROW_NUMBER)
    WITH MaxWinRate AS (
        SELECT 
            代號, 
            Hold_Days AS Max_Win_Days,
            Win_Rate * 100 AS Max_Win_Rate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY Win_Rate DESC, Hold_Days ASC) AS Rn_Win
        FROM #MetricsByHoldDays
    ),
    MaxReturn AS (
        SELECT 
            代號, 
            Hold_Days AS Max_Ret_Days,
            Avg_Return * 100 AS Max_Ret,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY Avg_Return DESC, Hold_Days ASC) AS Rn_Ret
        FROM #MetricsByHoldDays
    )
    -- 5. 使用 MERGE 一鍵更新/寫入目標資料表
    MERGE INTO dbo.StockPersonality_S15 AS Target
    USING (
        SELECT 
            W.代號,
            W.Max_Win_Rate AS 最高勝率,
            W.Max_Win_Days AS 最高勝率天數,
            R.Max_Ret AS 最大平均報酬,
            R.Max_Ret_Days AS 最大報酬天數
        FROM MaxWinRate W
        INNER JOIN MaxReturn R ON W.代號 = R.代號
        WHERE W.Rn_Win = 1 AND R.Rn_Ret = 1
    ) AS Source
    ON Target.代號 = Source.代號
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET 
            最高勝率 = Source.最高勝率,
            最高勝率天數 = Source.最高勝率天數,
            最大平均報酬 = Source.最大平均報酬,
            最大報酬天數 = Source.最大報酬天數,
            更新時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 最高勝率, 最高勝率天數, 最大平均報酬, 最大報酬天數)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.最高勝率, Source.最高勝率天數, Source.最大平均報酬, Source.最大報酬天數);

    PRINT '✅ [StockPersonality_S15] 15分級別股性回測更新完畢！';
END
GO

        (Price_T19 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T19,
        (Price_T20 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T20,
        (Price_T21 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T21,
        (Price_T22 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T22,
        (Price_T23 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T23,
        (Price_T24 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T24,
        (Price_T25 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T25,
        (Price_T26 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T26,
        (Price_T27 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T27,
        (Price_T28 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T28,
        (Price_T29 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T29,
        (Price_T30 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T30
    INTO #TriggerReturns
    FROM #RawFuturePrices
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 >= 15.0 AND (Prev_Score < 15.0 OR Prev_Score IS NULL);

    -- 3. 利用 CROSS APPLY 將 1~30 天欄位進行橫向轉置 (Unpivot)，快速計算各持有期的勝率與平均報酬
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MetricsByHoldDays') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MetricsByHoldDays;

    SELECT 
        代號, 
        Hold_Days,
        AVG(Ret) AS Avg_Return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) / COUNT(*) AS Win_Rate
    INTO #MetricsByHoldDays
    FROM #TriggerReturns
    CROSS APPLY (
        VALUES 
        (1, Ret_T1), (2, Ret_T2), (3, Ret_T3), (4, Ret_T4), (5, Ret_T5),
        (6, Ret_T6), (7, Ret_T7), (8, Ret_T8), (9, Ret_T9), (10, Ret_T10),
        (11, Ret_T11), (12, Ret_T12), (13, Ret_T13), (14, Ret_T14), (15, Ret_T15),
        (16, Ret_T16), (17, Ret_T17), (18, Ret_T18), (19, Ret_T19), (20, Ret_T20),
        (21, Ret_T21), (22, Ret_T22), (23, Ret_T23), (24, Ret_T24), (25, Ret_T25),
        (26, Ret_T26), (27, Ret_T27), (28, Ret_T28), (29, Ret_T29), (30, Ret_T30)
    ) AS V(Hold_Days, Ret)
    GROUP BY 代號, Hold_Days;

    -- 4. 找出每檔股票勝率最高、以及平均報酬率最高的最佳持有天數 (採用 CTE 與 ROW_NUMBER)
    WITH MaxWinRate AS (
        SELECT 
            代號, 
            Hold_Days AS Max_Win_Days,
            Win_Rate * 100 AS Max_Win_Rate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY Win_Rate DESC, Hold_Days ASC) AS Rn_Win
        FROM #MetricsByHoldDays
    ),
    MaxReturn AS (
        SELECT 
            代號, 
            Hold_Days AS Max_Ret_Days,
            Avg_Return * 100 AS Max_Ret,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY Avg_Return DESC, Hold_Days ASC) AS Rn_Ret
        FROM #MetricsByHoldDays
    )
    -- 5. 使用 MERGE 一鍵更新/寫入目標資料表
    MERGE INTO dbo.StockPersonality_S15 AS Target
    USING (
        SELECT 
            W.代號,
            W.Max_Win_Rate AS 最高勝率,
            W.Max_Win_Days AS 最高勝率天數,
            R.Max_Ret AS 最大平均報酬,
            R.Max_Ret_Days AS 最大報酬天數
        FROM MaxWinRate W
        INNER JOIN MaxReturn R ON W.代號 = R.代號
        WHERE W.Rn_Win = 1 AND R.Rn_Ret = 1
    ) AS Source
    ON Target.代號 = Source.代號
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET 
            最高勝率 = Source.最高勝率,
            最高勝率天數 = Source.最高勝率天數,
            最大平均報酬 = Source.最大平均報酬,
            最大報酬天數 = Source.最大報酬天數,
            更新時間 = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (代號, 最高勝率, 最高勝率天數, 最大平均報酬, 最大報酬天數)
        VALUES (Source.代號, Source.最高勝率, Source.最高勝率天數, Source.最大平均報酬, Source.最大報酬天數);

    PRINT '✅ [StockPersonality_S15] 15分級別股性回測更新完畢！';
END
GO

sql
USE [stockchangedate]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalHoldingPeriod15]
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. 建立帶有行號的歷史紀錄
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #HistoryWithIdx
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE 代號 = @TargetStockId;

    -- 2. 找出所有專家分數 > 15 的「進場點」 (已修正為 15 分起漲伏兵點)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    
    SELECT * INTO #SignalPoints FROM #HistoryWithIdx WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15;

    -- 3. 執行暴力掃描 (1-30天)
    -- 注意：WITH 前面的分號是強制的
    ;WITH DaysSeq(n) AS (
        SELECT 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n + 1 FROM DaysSeq WHERE n < 30
    ),
    AllScans AS (
        SELECT
            D.n AS 持股天數,
            S.日期 AS 進場日,
            S.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
            H.盤中現價 AS 賣出價,
            CASE WHEN H.盤中現價 > S.盤中現價 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsWin,
            (H.盤中現價 / NULLIF(S.盤中現價, 0) - 1) * 100 AS ReturnPct
        FROM #SignalPoints S
        CROSS JOIN DaysSeq D
        LEFT JOIN #HistoryWithIdx H ON H.RowIdx = S.RowIdx + D.n
    )
    -- 4. 彙總統計排名
    SELECT
        持股天數,
        COUNT(賣出價) AS 訊號樣本數,
        SUM(IsWin) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(IsWin) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(賣出價), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
        ROUND(AVG(ReturnPct), 2) AS 平均每筆報酬率,
        ROUND(SUM(ReturnPct), 2) AS 歷史累計總報酬
    FROM AllScans
    WHERE 賣出價 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 持股天數
    ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均每筆報酬率 DESC
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 31); -- 確保遞迴正常結束

    -- 清理暫存表
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
END
GO

USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalHoldingPeriod1_s15]    Script Date: 2026/7/13 下午 05:15:00 /

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalHoldingPeriod1_s15]
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. 建立帶有行號的歷史紀錄 (針對單股運算極快)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #HistoryWithIdx
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE 代號 = @TargetStockId;

    -- 2. 找出所有進場點 (已修正為 15 分起漲伏兵點)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    SELECT * INTO #SignalPoints FROM #HistoryWithIdx WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15;

    -- 3. 執行 1-30 天暴力掃描運算
    ;WITH DaysSeq(n) AS (
        SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM DaysSeq WHERE n < 30
    ),
    AllStats AS (
        SELECT
            D.n AS 持股天數,
            COUNT(H.盤中現價) AS 訊號樣本數,
            SUM(CASE WHEN H.盤中現價 > S.盤中現價 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 獲利次數,
            ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN H.盤中現價 > S.盤中現價 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(H.盤中現價), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
            ROUND(AVG((H.盤中現價 / NULLIF(S.盤中現價, 0) - 1) * 100), 2) AS 平均報酬率
        FROM #SignalPoints S
        CROSS JOIN DaysSeq D
        LEFT JOIN #HistoryWithIdx H ON H.RowIdx = S.RowIdx + D.n
        GROUP BY D.n
    ),
    RankedStats AS (
        -- 針對勝率與報酬率進行排名
        SELECT *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均報酬率 DESC) as BestRank
        FROM AllStats
        WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 3 -- 確保樣本數足夠，避免極端值
    )
    -- 4. 輸出結果：自動化決策建議 (只回傳前三名最優天數)
    SELECT 
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        BestRank AS 推薦順位,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均報酬率,
        訊號樣本數,
        -- 智慧性格判定邏輯
        CASE 
            WHEN 持股天數 <= 5 THEN N'快攻獵豹型'
            WHEN 持股天數 <= 12 THEN N'標準波段型'
            ELSE N'長線保護型'
        END AS 股性標籤
    FROM RankedStats
    WHERE BestRank <= 3
    ORDER BY BestRank ASC
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 31);

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
END
GO

USE [stockchangedate]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalHoldingPeriods15date]
    @TargetDate INT,         -- 起始統計日期 (例如 20260101)
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20) -- 股票代號
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立該股「全歷史」索引 (不限日期，為了讓進場點能對接到未來的賣出價)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #HistoryWithIdx
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(@TargetStockId); -- 確保代號對齊

    -- 2. 找出在「指定日期之後」所有專家分數 > 15 的「進場點」 (已修正為 15 分起漲伏兵點)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    
    SELECT * INTO #SignalPoints 
    FROM #HistoryWithIdx 
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15 
      AND 日期 >= @TargetDate; -- 只有進場訊號受日期參數限制

    -- 3. 執行 1-30 天持有期掃描
    ;WITH DaysSeq(n) AS (
        SELECT 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n + 1 FROM DaysSeq WHERE n < 30
    ),
    AllScans AS (
        SELECT
            D.n AS 持股天數,
            S.日期 AS 進場日,
            S.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
            H.盤中現價 AS 賣出價,
            CASE WHEN H.盤中現價 > S.盤中現價 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsWin,
            (H.盤中現價 / NULLIF(S.盤中現價, 0) - 1) * 100 AS ReturnPct
        FROM #SignalPoints S
        CROSS JOIN DaysSeq D
        -- 這裡 H 會去 #HistoryWithIdx 找 S 訊號日往後推 n 天的價格
        LEFT JOIN #HistoryWithIdx H ON H.RowIdx = S.RowIdx + D.n
    )
    -- 4. 彙總統計排名
    SELECT
        持股天數,
        COUNT(賣出價) AS 訊號樣本數,
        SUM(IsWin) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(IsWin) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(賣出價), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
        ROUND(AVG(ReturnPct), 2) AS 平均每筆報酬率,
        ROUND(SUM(ReturnPct), 2) AS 區間累計總報酬
    FROM AllScans
    WHERE 賣出價 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 持股天數
    ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均每筆報酬率 DESC
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 31);

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#HistoryWithIdx') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #HistoryWithIdx;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universal15]
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20), -- 變數 1：股票代號
    @Days INT                    -- 變數 2：回測天數 (例如 5 天或 10 天)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. 建立實體暫存表來存放運算結果
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BacktestTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BacktestTemp;

    -- 2. 使用 CTE 先運算 LEAD 指標，並過濾條件 (已修正為 15 分起漲伏兵點)
    WITH FullHistory AS (
        SELECT 
            名稱, 代號, 日期, 專家實戰總分, 盤中現價,
            LEAD(盤中現價, @Days) OVER (ORDER BY 日期) AS 未來價格,
            LEAD(日期, @Days) OVER (ORDER BY 日期) AS 結算日期
        FROM MasterStockAnalysis
        WHERE 代號 = @TargetStockId
    )
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROUND((未來價格 / 盤中現價 - 1) * 100, 2) AS 單次獲利百分比
    INTO #BacktestTemp
    FROM FullHistory
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15 -- 核心修正：15分伏兵進場點
      AND 未來價格 IS NOT NULL;

    -- 3. 第一個結果集：輸出詳細明細與「累計累加回報」(供網頁畫出權益曲線圖)
    SELECT 
        名稱, 
        代號, 
        日期 AS 訊號進場日, 
        專家實戰總分, 
        盤中現價 AS 買入價,
        結算日期 AS 預計出場日, 
        未來價格 AS 賣出價,
        單次獲利百分比 AS [N日回報百分比],
        ROUND(SUM(單次獲利百分比) OVER (ORDER BY 日期), 2) AS 累計累加回報
    FROM #BacktestTemp
    ORDER BY 日期;

    -- 4. 第二個結果集：輸出總體統計摘要 (讓網頁前端顯示勝率)
    SELECT 
        @TargetStockId AS 查詢代號,
        @Days AS 回測天數,
        COUNT(*) AS 總訊號次數,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN 單次獲利百分比 > 0 THEN 1 END) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(AVG(單次獲利百分比), 2) AS 平均單次獲利,
        ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN 單次獲利百分比 > 0 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS [總勝率%]
    FROM #BacktestTemp;

    -- 清理暫存表
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BacktestTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BacktestTemp;
END
GO

這是一套為您改寫完成的 `sp_GetStockBacktest_Universal1_s15` 預儲程序 [Database Architecture, Operational Manual]。 此程序完全沿用您原版中極具智慧的 `CROSS JOIN` 單一結果集扁平化技術 [Database Architecture]。它能讓每一筆交易明細（訊號日、買入價、出場日、累積報酬）右側，都自動緊跟著整檔股票在 15 分訊號下的「總勝率、平均獲利、總訊號次數」等關鍵統計指標 [Database Architecture, Operational Manual]。 這種單一結果集的設計，在與前端網頁、圖表元件進行對接時，能省去多結果集（Multiple Resultsets）的處理開銷，使網頁讀取與繪製權益曲線的速度達到極限 [Operational Manual]： --- ### 💾 雙對齊通用回測預儲程序：`[dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universal1_s15]` 請在您的 SSMS 中開啟新查詢，複製以下 T-SQL 語法並執行，即可完成建立：
sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universal1_s15]    Script Date: 2026/7/13 下午 05:30:00 /

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universal1_s15]
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20),
    @Days INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BacktestTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BacktestTemp;

    -- 1. 運算核心數據 (已修正為 15 分起漲伏兵點)
    WITH FullHistory AS (
        SELECT 名稱, 代號, 日期, 專家實戰總分, 盤中現價,
               LEAD(盤中現價, @Days) OVER (ORDER BY 日期) AS 未來價格,
               LEAD(日期, @Days) OVER (ORDER BY 日期) AS 結算日期
        FROM MasterStockAnalysis WHERE 代號 = @TargetStockId
    )
    SELECT *, ROUND((未來價格 / 盤中現價 - 1) * 100, 2) AS 單次獲利百分比
    INTO #BacktestTemp FROM FullHistory
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15 AND 未來價格 IS NOT NULL; -- 核心修正：15分伏兵進場點

    -- 2. 同時輸出明細與統計 (使用 CROSS JOIN 實現單一結果集扁平化)
    -- 這樣每一列後面都會帶著這檔股票的「總勝率」資訊，極便於網頁圖表解析
    SELECT 
        T.*,
        ROUND(SUM(T.單次獲利百分比) OVER (ORDER BY T.日期), 2) AS 累計累加回報,
        S.總訊號次數, S.獲利次數, S.總勝率, S.平均獲利
    FROM #BacktestTemp T
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) AS 總訊號次數,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN 單次獲利百分比 > 0 THEN 1 END) AS 獲利次數,
            ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN 單次獲利百分比 > 0 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS 總勝率,
            ROUND(AVG(單次獲利百分比), 2) AS 平均獲利
        FROM #BacktestTemp
    ) S
    ORDER BY T.日期;

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BacktestTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BacktestTemp;
END
GO

sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universals15date]    Script Date: 2026/7/13 下午 05:40:00 /
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStockBacktest_Universals15date]
    @StartDate INT,            -- 統計起日 (例如 20260101)
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20), -- 股票代號
    @Days INT                  -- 預定持有天數
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立該股「全歷史」索引 (每一天都有一個唯一的 RowIdx，針對單股運算極快)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #History
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(@TargetStockId);

    -- 取得全表最後一天的資訊 (用於處理未結算的浮動損益)
    DECLARE @MaxRowIdx INT, @LatestPrice FLOAT, @LatestDate INT;
    SELECT TOP 1 @MaxRowIdx = RowIdx, @LatestPrice = 盤中現價, @LatestDate = 日期 
    FROM #History ORDER BY RowIdx DESC;

    -- 2. 找出「起日之後」且「總分 > 15」的進場點 (已修正為 15分起漲伏兵點)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    SELECT * INTO #SignalPoints FROM #History 
    WHERE 專家實戰總分 > 15 AND 日期 >= @StartDate;

    -- 3. 執行回測運算 (將進場點的 RowIdx 直接加 @Days)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalResult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalResult;
    
    SELECT 
        @TargetStockId as 代號,
        S.日期 AS 進場日期, 
        S.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
        -- 核心修正：使用 S.RowIdx (原始歷史序號) 往後加天數
        CASE 
            WHEN (S.RowIdx + @Days) <= @MaxRowIdx THEN H.日期 
            ELSE @LatestDate 
        END AS 實際計算日,
        CASE 
            WHEN (S.RowIdx + @Days) <= @MaxRowIdx THEN H.盤中現價 
            ELSE @LatestPrice 
        END AS 實際計算價,
        -- 交易狀態標籤 (區分已結算與進行中)
        CASE 
            WHEN (S.RowIdx + @Days) <= @MaxRowIdx THEN N'✅ 已結算' 
            ELSE N'⏳ 進行中(浮動)' 
        END AS 交易狀態
    INTO #FinalResult
    FROM #SignalPoints S
    LEFT JOIN #History H ON H.RowIdx = S.RowIdx + @Days;

    -- 4. 輸出最終扁平化報表 (CROSS JOIN 統計欄位，極便於網頁對接)
    SELECT 
        R.代號, R.進場日期, R.買入價, 
        R.實際計算日 AS [結算/今日], 
        R.實際計算價 AS [結算/現價],
        R.交易狀態,
        ROUND((R.實際計算價 / NULLIF(R.買入價, 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS [獲利%],
        ROUND(SUM(ROUND((R.實際計算價 / NULLIF(R.買入價, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) OVER (ORDER BY R.進場日期), 2) AS [累計回報曲線],
        S.總訊號次數, S.已結算次數, S.勝率, S.平均獲利
    FROM #FinalResult R
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) AS 總訊號次數,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN 交易狀態 = N'✅ 已結算' THEN 1 END) AS 已結算次數,
            ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN (實際計算價 > 買入價) THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS 勝率,
            ROUND(AVG((實際計算價 / NULLIF(買入價, 0) - 1) * 100), 2) AS 平均獲利
        FROM #FinalResult
    ) S
    ORDER BY R.進場日期;

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SignalPoints') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SignalPoints;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalResult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalResult;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END
GO

這個戰略思想在量化投資（Quantitative Trading）中被稱為 「超參數網格搜索（Hyperparameter Grid Search）」 [Database Architecture, Operational Manual, WeeklyMA60Snapshot, Anue鉅亨網]！ 這正是頂級量化交易系統（如 QuantConnect 或本地回測引擎）最核心的功能：我們不只測試單一進場點，而是讓電腦在背景自動橫掃「進場分數（10 ~ 40分）」與「持股天數（1 ~ 30天）」的所有交叉組合（共 210 種排列組合），自動為您篩選出這檔股票最賺錢、勝率最高的 「黃金黃金策略解」 [Database Architecture, Operational Manual]。 以下為您編寫這支全新、極致高效的網格搜索預儲程序： `[dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]` [Database Architecture, Operational Manual]： --- ### 💾 終極網格搜索預儲程序：`[dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]` 此程序會在背景自動進行「雙維度（分數 $\times$ 天數）」的網格交叉運算。 執行完畢後，它會自動為您輸出兩個高價值的結果集： 1. 結果集一：勝率最高的前 5 名黃金組合。 2. 結果集二：平均單次報酬率最高的前 5 名黃金組合。 請在您的 SSMS 中開啟新查詢，複製以下 T-SQL 語法並執行，即可完成建立 [Database Architecture]：
sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]    Script Date: 2026/7/14 上午 09:30:00 /
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20) -- 變數：輸入您要查詢的股票代號 (如 N'2330')
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立該股的全歷史索引暫存表 (極速單股運算)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #History
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(@TargetStockId);

    -- 2. 建立 1~30 天未來價格探測表 (LEAD 視窗運算)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;

    SELECT 
        H.日期, H.RowIdx, H.盤中現價, H.專家實戰總分,
        LAG(H.專家實戰總分, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Prev_Score,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T1,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 2) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T2,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 3) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T3,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 4) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T4,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 5) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T5,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 6) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T6,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 7) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T7,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 8) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T8,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 9) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T9,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 10) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T10,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 11) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T11,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 12) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T12,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 13) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T13,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 14) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T14,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 15) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T15,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 16) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T16,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 17) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T17,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 18) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T18,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 19) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T19,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 20) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T20,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 21) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T21,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 22) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T22,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 23) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T23,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 24) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T24,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 25) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T25,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 26) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T26,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 27) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T27,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 28) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T28,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 29) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T29,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 30) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T30
    INTO #FuturePrices
    FROM #History H;

    -- 3. 定義要掃描的「專家進攻分數」梯度 (10分、15分、20分、25分、30分、35分、40分)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    SELECT val AS Threshold INTO #Thresholds FROM (VALUES (10), (15), (20), (25), (30), (35), (40)) AS V(val);

    -- 4. 交叉相乘：計算「每一個分數門檻」下，每一次進場後 1~30 天的相對報酬率
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;

    SELECT 
        Trig.Threshold AS 買入分數門檻,
        FP.日期 AS 進場日期,
        FP.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
        (Price_T1 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T1,
        (Price_T2 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T2,
        (Price_T3 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T3,
        (Price_T4 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T4,
        (Price_T5 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T5,
        (Price_T6 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T6,
        (Price_T7 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T7,
        (Price_T8 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T8,
        (Price_T9 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T9,
        (Price_T10 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T10,
        (Price_T11 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T11,
        (Price_T12 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T12,
        (Price_T13 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T13,
        (Price_T14 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T14,
        (Price_T15 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T15,
        (Price_T16 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T16,
        (Price_T17 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T17,
        (Price_T18 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T18,
        (Price_T19 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T19,
        (Price_T20 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T20,
        (Price_T21 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T21,
        (Price_T22 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T22,
        (Price_T23 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T23,
        (Price_T24 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T24,
        (Price_T25 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T25,
        (Price_T26 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T26,
        (Price_T27 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T27,
        (Price_T28 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T28,
        (Price_T29 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T29,
        (Price_T30 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T30
    INTO #TriggerReturns
    FROM #FuturePrices FP
    CROSS JOIN #Thresholds Trig
    WHERE FP.專家實戰總分 >= Trig.Threshold 
      AND (FP.Prev_Score < Trig.Threshold OR FP.Prev_Score IS NULL);

    -- 5. 轉置並歸納 210 種「買入分數 ✕ 持股天數」交叉網格的勝率與平均報酬
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;

    SELECT 
        買入分數門檻,
        Hold_Days AS 持股天數,
        COUNT(*) AS 訊號樣本數,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
        ROUND(AVG(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 平均單次報酬率,
        ROUND(SUM(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 區間累計總報酬
    INTO #GridResults
    FROM #TriggerReturns TR
    CROSS APPLY (
        VALUES 
        (1, Ret_T1), (2, Ret_T2), (3, Ret_T3), (4, Ret_T4), (5, Ret_T5),
        (6, Ret_T6), (7, Ret_T7), (8, Ret_T8), (9, Ret_T9), (10, Ret_T10),
        (11, Ret_T11), (12, Ret_T12), (13, Ret_T13), (14, Ret_T14), (15, Ret_T15),
        (16, Ret_T16), (17, Ret_T17), (18, Ret_T18), (19, Ret_T19), (20, Ret_T20),
        (21, Ret_T21), (22, Ret_T22), (23, Ret_T23), (24, Ret_T24), (25, Ret_T25),
        (26, Ret_T26), (27, Ret_T27), (28, Ret_T28), (29, Ret_T29), (30, Ret_T30)
    ) AS V(Hold_Days, Ret)
    WHERE Ret IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 買入分數門檻, Hold_Days;

    -- ==========================================
    -- 【輸出結果一】：篩選出 勝率最高 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- ==========================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'🏆 最佳勝率推薦' AS 推薦類別,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC) AS 推薦順位,
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值，確保統計有效性
    ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC;

    -- ==========================================
    -- 【輸出結果二】：篩選出 平均單次報酬率最高 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- ==========================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'💰 最大報酬推薦' AS 推薦類別,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 平均單次報酬率 DESC, [勝率%] DESC) AS 推薦順位,
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值
    ORDER BY 平均單次報酬率 DESC, [勝率%] DESC;

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END
GO

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]
    @StartDate INT,            -- 變數 1：統計起日 (例如 20250101)
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20) -- 變數 2：輸入您要查詢的股票代號 (如 N'2330')
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立該股的全歷史索引暫存表 (保留全時序)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #History
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(@TargetStockId);

    -- 2. 建立 1~30 天未來價格探測表 (LEAD 視窗運算)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;

    SELECT 
        H.日期, H.RowIdx, H.盤中現價, H.專家實戰總分,
        LAG(H.專家實戰總分, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Prev_Score,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T1,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 2) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T2,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 3) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T3,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 4) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T4,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 5) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T5,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 6) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T6,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 7) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T7,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 8) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T8,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 9) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T9,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 10) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T10,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 11) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T11,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 12) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T12,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 13) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T13,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 14) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T14,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 15) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T15,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 16) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T16,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 17) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T17,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 18) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T18,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 19) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T19,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 20) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T20,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 21) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T21,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 22) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T22,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 23) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T23,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 24) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T24,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 25) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T25,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 26) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T26,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 27) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T27,
        LEAD(H.盤重現價, 28) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T28,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 29) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T29,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 30) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T30
    INTO #FuturePrices
    FROM #History H;

    #FuturePrices 修正: 修正 Price_T28 的拼字錯誤
    SET @LatestDate = 0; -- 僅為預編譯保留，無影響
    ALTER TABLE #FuturePrices ALTER COLUMN 專家實戰總分 DECIMAL(10, 2); -- 安全校正

    -- 3. 定義要掃描的「專家進攻分數」門檻 (10分 ~ 40分)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    SELECT val AS Threshold INTO #Thresholds FROM (VALUES (10), (15), (20), (25), (30), (35), (40)) AS V(val);

    -- 4. 交叉相乘：計算「每一個分數門檻」下，每一次進場後 1~30 天的相對報酬率
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;

    SELECT

        FP.日期 AS 進場日期,
        FP.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
        (Price_T1 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T1,
        (Price_T2 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T2,
        (Price_T3 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T3,
        (Price_T4 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T4,

        (Price_T7 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T7,
        (Price_T8 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T8,
        (Price_T9 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T9,
        (Price_T10 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T10,
        (Price_T11 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T11,
        (Price_T12 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T12,
        (Price_T13 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T13,
        (Price_T14 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T14,
        (Price_T15 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T15,
        (Price_T16 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T16,
        (Price_T17 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T17,
        (Price_T18 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T18,
        (Price_T19 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T19,
        (Price_T20 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T20,
        (Price_T21 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T21,
        (Price_T22 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T22,
        (Price_T23 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T23,
        (Price_T24 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T24,
        (Price_T25 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T25,
        (Price_T26 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T26,
        (Price_T27 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T27,
        (Price_T28 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T28,
        (Price_T29 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T29,
        (Price_T30 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T30
    INTO #TriggerReturns
    FROM #FuturePrices FP
    CROSS JOIN #Thresholds Trig
    WHERE FP.專家實戰總分 >= Trig.Threshold 
      AND (FP.Prev_Score < Trig.Threshold OR FP.Prev_Score IS NULL)
      AND FP.日期 >= @StartDate; -- 🛠️【核心新增】：日期過濾精確應用於訊號觸發，完整保留未來扣抵天數

    -- 5. 轉置並歸納 210 種「買入分數 ✕ 持股天數」交叉網格的勝率與平均報酬
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;

    SELECT 
        買入分數門檻,
        Hold_Days AS 持股天數,
        COUNT(*) AS 訊號樣本數,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
        ROUND(AVG(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 平均單次報酬率,
        ROUND(SUM(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 區間累計總報酬
    INTO #GridResults
    FROM #TriggerReturns TR
    CROSS APPLY (
        VALUES 
        (1, Ret_T1), (2, Ret_T2), (3, Ret_T3), (4, Ret_T4), (5, Ret_T5),
        (6, Ret_T6), (7, Ret_T7), (8, Ret_T8), (9, Ret_T9), (10, Ret_T10),
        (11, Ret_T11), (12, Ret_T12), (13, Ret_T13), (14, Ret_T14), (15, Ret_T15),
        (16, Ret_T16), (17, Ret_T17), (18, Ret_T18), (19, Ret_T19), (20, Ret_T20),
        (21, Ret_T21), (22, Ret_T22), (23, Ret_T23), (24, Ret_T24), (25, Ret_T25),
        (26, Ret_T26), (27, Ret_T27), (28, Ret_T28), (29, Ret_T29), (30, Ret_T30)
    ) AS V(Hold_Days, Ret)
    WHERE Ret IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 買入分數門檻, Hold_Days;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 【輸出結果一】：篩選出 勝率最高 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'🏆 最佳勝率推薦' AS 推薦類別,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC) AS 推薦順位,
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值，確保統計有效性
    ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 【輸出結果二】：篩選出 區間累計總報酬最高（複利金額最大） 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'💰 最大累計報酬推薦' AS 推薦類別, -- 已修改為動態累計報酬標題
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 區間累計總報酬 DESC, [勝率%] DESC) AS 推薦順位, -- 已修正為按區間累計總報酬排序
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值
    ORDER BY 區間累計總報酬 DESC, [勝率%] DESC; -- 已修正為按區間累計總報酬排序

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END
GO

sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]    Script Date: 2026/7/14 下午 10:45:00 /
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]
    @StartDate INT,            -- 變數 1：統計起日 (例如 20250101)
    @TargetStockId NVARCHAR(20) -- 變數 2：輸入您要查詢的股票代號 (如 N'2330')
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    -- 1. 建立該股的全歷史索引暫存表 (保留全時序)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    
    SELECT 
        日期, 盤中現價, 專家實戰總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 日期) as RowIdx
    INTO #History
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis
    WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(@TargetStockId);

    -- 2. 建立 1~30 天未來價格探測表 (LEAD 視窗運算)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;

    SELECT 
        H.日期, H.RowIdx, H.盤中現價, H.專家實戰總分,
        LAG(H.專家實戰總分, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Prev_Score,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 1) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T1,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 2) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T2,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 3) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T3,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 4) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T4,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 5) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T5,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 6) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T6,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 7) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T7,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 8) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T8,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 9) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T9,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 10) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T10,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 11) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T11,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 12) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T12,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 13) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T13,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 14) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T14,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 15) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T15,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 16) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T16,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 17) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T17,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 18) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T18,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 19) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T19,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 20) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T20,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 21) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T21,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 22) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T22,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 23) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T23,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 24) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T24,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 25) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T25,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 26) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T26,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 27) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T27,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 28) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T28, -- 已直接修正為正確的「盤中現價」
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 29) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T29,
        LEAD(H.盤中現價, 30) OVER (ORDER BY H.日期) AS Price_T30
    INTO #FuturePrices
    FROM #History H;

    -- 3. 定義要掃描的「專家進攻分數」門檻 (10分 ~ 40分)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    SELECT val AS Threshold INTO #Thresholds FROM (VALUES (10), (15), (20), (25), (30), (35), (40)) AS V(val);

    -- 4. 交叉相乘：計算「每一個分數門檻」下，每一次進場後 1~30 天的相對報酬率
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;

    SELECT 
        Trig.Threshold AS 買入分數門檻,
        FP.日期 AS 進場日期,
        FP.盤中現價 AS 買入價,
        (Price_T1 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T1,
        (Price_T2 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T2,
        (Price_T3 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T3,
        (Price_T4 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T4,
        (Price_T5 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T5,
        (Price_T6 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T6,
        (Price_T7 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T7,
        (Price_T8 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T8,
        (Price_T9 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T9,
        (Price_T10 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T10,
        (Price_T11 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T11,
        (Price_T12 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T12,
        (Price_T13 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T13,
        (Price_T14 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T14,
        (Price_T15 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T15,
        (Price_T16 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T16,
        (Price_T17 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T17,
        (Price_T18 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T18,
        (Price_T19 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T19,
        (Price_T20 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T20,
        (Price_T21 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T21,
        (Price_T22 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T22,
        (Price_T23 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T23,
        (Price_T24 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T24,
        (Price_T25 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T25,
        (Price_T26 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T26,
        (Price_T27 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T27,
        (Price_T28 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T28,
        (Price_T29 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T29,
        (Price_T30 - 盤中現價) / NULLIF(盤中現價, 0) AS Ret_T30
    INTO #TriggerReturns
    FROM #FuturePrices FP
    CROSS JOIN #Thresholds Trig
    WHERE FP.專家實戰總分 >= Trig.Threshold 
      AND (FP.Prev_Score < Trig.Threshold OR FP.Prev_Score IS NULL)
      AND FP.日期 >= @StartDate; -- 日期過濾精確應用於此，完整保留未來扣抵時序

    -- 5. 轉置並歸納 210 種「買入分數 ✕ 持股天數」交叉網格的勝率與平均報酬
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;

    SELECT 
        買入分數門檻,
        Hold_Days AS 持股天數,
        COUNT(*) AS 訊號樣本數,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 獲利次數,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Ret > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS [勝率%],
        ROUND(AVG(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 平均單次報酬率,
        ROUND(SUM(Ret) * 100, 2) AS 區間累計總報酬
    INTO #GridResults
    FROM #TriggerReturns TR
    CROSS APPLY (
        VALUES 
        (1, Ret_T1), (2, Ret_T2), (3, Ret_T3), (4, Ret_T4), (5, Ret_T5),
        (6, Ret_T6), (7, Ret_T7), (8, Ret_T8), (9, Ret_T9), (10, Ret_T10),
        (11, Ret_T11), (12, Ret_T12), (13, Ret_T13), (14, Ret_T14), (15, Ret_T15),
        (16, Ret_T16), (17, Ret_T17), (18, Ret_T18), (19, Ret_T19), (20, Ret_T20),
        (21, Ret_T21), (22, Ret_T22), (23, Ret_T23), (24, Ret_T24), (25, Ret_T25),
        (26, Ret_T26), (27, Ret_T27), (28, Ret_T28), (29, Ret_T29), (30, Ret_T30)
    ) AS V(Hold_Days, Ret)
    WHERE Ret IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 買入分數門檻, Hold_Days;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 【輸出結果一】：篩選出 勝率最高 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'🏆 最佳勝率推薦' AS 推薦類別,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC) AS 推薦順位,
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值，確保統計有效性
    ORDER BY [勝率%] DESC, 平均單次報酬率 DESC;

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 【輸出結果二】：篩選出 區間累計總報酬最高（複利金額最大） 的前 5 大黃金策略
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT TOP 5
        @TargetStockId AS 股票代號,
        N'💰 最大累計報酬推薦' AS 推薦類別,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 區間累計總報酬 DESC, [勝率%] DESC) AS 推薦順位,
        買入分數門檻,
        持股天數,
        [勝率%],
        平均單次報酬率,
        區間累計總報酬,
        訊號樣本數
    FROM #GridResults
    WHERE 訊號樣本數 >= 5 -- 過濾樣本過少的極端值
    ORDER BY 區間累計總報酬 DESC, [勝率%] DESC;

    -- 清理
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#History') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #History;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FuturePrices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FuturePrices;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Thresholds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Thresholds;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TriggerReturns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TriggerReturns;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResults;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END

sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO
/ Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_FindOptimalStrategy_GridSearch]    Script Date: 2026/7/14 下午 11:00:00 /
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
